description: Anime sometimes called Japanimation, is hand-drawn and computer animation originating from Japan. The term anime is derived from the English word animation, and in Japan is used to refer to all forms of animated media. Outside Japan, the term refers specifically to animation from Japan or to a Japanese-disseminated animation style often characterized by colorful graphics, vibrant characters and fantastical themes. This culturally abstract approach to the word's meaning may open the possibility of anime produced in countries other than Japan. The earliest commercial Japanese animation dates to 1917. A characteristic art style emerged in the 1960s with the works of Osamu Tezuka and spread in the second half of the 20th century, developing a large domestic and international audience. Anime can be distributed theatrically, by way of television broadcasts, directly to home media, and over the Internet. In addition to completely original works, anime are often adaptations of Japanese comics (known as manga), light novels, or video games. Production methods and techniques related to anime have adapted over time in response to emergent technologies. As a multimedia art form, it combines graphic art, characterization, cinematography, and other creative techniques. Anime production typically focuses less on the animation of movement and more on the realism of settings as well as the use of camera effects, including panning, zooming, and angle shots. Diverse art styles are used, and character proportions and features can be quite varied, including characteristically large or realistically sized emotive eyes. Anime is classified into numerous genres targeting both broad and niche audiences.

The first game was released in 2006 and the most recently in 2013. Later games have been released on Microsoft Windows, Linux, Android and iOS. ARMA: Armed Assault, known as ARMA: Combat Operations in the United States, is the first ARMA game, released for Microsoft Windows in November 2006 (Czech Republic/Germany), February 2007 (Europe) and May 2007 (U.S.) using the Real Virtuality 2. ARMA 3 is a standalone game for Microsoft Windows that released on September 12, 2013 using the Real Virtuality 4 game engine. It was first open to the public on March 5, 2013 using Steam's Early Access program. In late 2015 – early 2016 it was also released for Linux and Mac in an earlier version, aiming to catch up with the main Windows version later.

title: Hexa Balance Tower
description: Crush, blast, and toss this tower of blocks to the ground. Ultimately, the goal is to descend to balance the hexagon (a six-sided geometry) while keeping it from dropping. To win, you must go to the flag just at the bottom of the tower. Mathematical equations, logic problems, strategy, and reflexes are all included in the game mechanism. It's a simple game with riddles and arcade features that anyone can learn quickly. It is difficult to learn and can be difficult to master. The mechanics of the game •A hexagon shape (hex or Hexa) is positioned on top of a stack of bricks or mines (see illustration). Although you cannot move the hexagon, you may smash the blocks around it to get the hexagon closer to the earth. The blocks function similarly to mines in that they will be destroyed if you tap on them. When the tower begins to wobble, it may begin to topple; take care not to let the hex fall. • The game is over if the hexagon loses its balance and falls into the abyss. To win the game, you must maneuver the hexagon from the top to the bottom of the tower until it hits the ground and captures the flag on the other side. The stages are similar to puzzles in that you must choose carefully which block of mines to crush to prevent the tower structure from collapsing and disintegrating completely. When blocks are destroyed, they will vanish, and the tower/structure will grow shorter due to the destruction. However, not only would the block you tap be crushed, but it may also affect adjacent blocks, allowing the stack to roll, fall, or slip as a result of the impact. As a result, the hexagon will react to the rules of physics (it has several sides, so it's nearly like a ball)—make sure it doesn't fall before it hits the ground! Thus, deciding which bricks to smash is the puzzle game aspect.

description: Scuffed Uno lets you play the popular Uno card game in your web browser. The aim of the game is to be the first player with no cards, similar to other Crazy Eights style card games. Play Scuffed Uno with 2, 3, or 4 players. How to Play Scuffed Uno There are various strategies you can use to maximize your chances of winning at Uno. The main principle is to get rid of all your cards before everyone else. You can do that by matching the color or number of the card placed down before yours. If you don\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\t have a playable card, you must draw cards from the pile until you do. When you have one card left, press the \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\UNO\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\ button, otherwise you will be punished with two penalty cards! Number cards There are 108 cards in total. Number cards make up 70% of the total deck, with four colors each containing 19 cards. The cards span from numbers 0-9. As for the quantity of each card, there is one zero card, and two of every other number. The remaining 30% of cards are called action cards and wild cards. Action cards Action cards add an extra level of strategy to Uno. There are three action card types in an Uno deck. There are two of each action card in each color. These are: Skip card - the next player in the sequence misses a turn. Reverse - reverses the direction of play. Draw two - the next player draws two cards and misses one turn. Wild cards There are two types of wild card with four of each one. They are: Wild - lets the player choose what color to play. Wild draw 4 - declare the next color to match, and force the next player to draw four cards.

title: Above and Below Solitaire
description: The game is played with 2 decks of cards. At first, a card is dealt face up as an "indicator". 4 foundation piles are to be built up from cards of the same suit, starting from cards one rank above the indicator, wrapping from A to K as necessary. Similarly, 4 other foundation piles are to be built down from cards of the same suit starting from cards one rank below the indicator and wrapping from K to A as necessary. The stock cards are dealt one by one to the waste pile. When a card with the same rank as the indicator shows up, you can directly move it to the indicator pile. You can move the top card in a waste pile to the foundations or one of the 4 tableau piles. The tableau piles are built up or down with cards of the same suit, each time you can move only one card from the tableau piles. When the stock cards are all dealt, you can collect the waste cards as the stock cards and have one more go. You can also move cards between foundation piles, this gives you slightly better chance in winning this difficult game. The more cards you move to the foundation piles, the higher your rank.

title: Nonogram
description: Japanese crosswords (nonogram) are a very fascinating type of graphical crossword puzzles that develop logic, figurative thinking and erudition. Japanese crossword is a puzzle, in which with the help of numbers some image is encrypted. The aim of the puzzle is to completely reconstruct this image. Numbers listed at the left and top of the crossword puzzle describe groups of shaded cells (going in a row, without gaps) horizontally and vertically, respectively. And the order of these numbers describes the order of these groups, but where each group begins and ends - is unknown (in fact, to determine their position and is the task of the puzzle). Each digit represents a separate group of a given size (i.e. digit 5 represents a group of five consecutive colored cells, 1 represents a group of one single colored cell). There must be at least one unpainted cell between groups of the same color.

title: Chinese 2048
description: 2048 is often played on a plain 4×4 grid, with numbered tiles that slide when a player moves them using the four arrow keys. Every turn, a new tile randomly appears in an empty spot on the board with a value of either 2 or 4. Tiles slide as far as possible in the chosen direction until they are stopped by either another tile or the edge of the grid. If two tiles of the same number collide while moving, they will merge into a tile with the total value of the two tiles that collided. The resulting tile cannot merge with another tile again in the same move. Higher-scoring tiles emit a soft glow, and the highest possible tile is 131,072. If a move causes three consecutive tiles of the same value to slide together, only the two tiles farthest along the direction of motion will combine. If all four spaces in a row or column are filled with tiles of the same value, a move parallel to that row/column will combine the first two and last two. A scoreboard on the upper-right keeps track of the user's score. The user's score starts at zero and is increased whenever two tiles combine, by the value of the new tile. The game is won when a tile with a value of 2048 appears on the board, hence the name of the game. After reaching the 2048 tile, players can continue to play (beyond the 2048 tile) to reach higher scores. When the player has no legal moves (there are no empty spaces and no adjacent tiles with the same value), the game ends.

title: Simple Tic Tac Toe
description: Tic Tac Toe is a classic two-player game that can be played on a computer. To play the game, simply click on the square where you want to place your symbol. The game will alternate turns between the two players until a winner is declared or the game is tied. The player with the most wins at the end of the series is the ultimate winner. Tic Tac Toe is a simple and fun game that can be played by people of all ages. It stars the voices of Rosalie Chiang, Sandra Oh, Ava Morse, Hyein Park, Maitreyi Ramakrishnan, Orion Lee, Wai Ching Ho, Tristan Allerick Chen, and James Hong. Set in Toronto, Ontario, in 2002, Turning Red follows Meilin "Mei" Lee, a 13-year-old Chinese-Canadian student who, due to a hereditary curse, transforms into a giant red panda when she expresses any strong emotion. Inspired by Shi's experiences growing up in Toronto, the film began development in 2018 after she pitched it to Pixar in October 2017. It is the first Pixar film solely directed by a woman and the second to feature an Asian lead character after Up (2009). Special screenings of Turning Red took place in London at Everyman Borough Yards on February 21, 2022, and in Toronto at TIFF Bell Lightbox on March 8. The film had its world premiere at the El Capitan Theatre in Los Angeles on March 1, and was released on the Disney+ streaming service on March 11, along with simultaneous limited in certain theaters. It was released theatrically in most countries without Disney+, grossing a total of $17.1 million worldwide, and received critical acclaim.

title: Shrek Card Match
description: Shrek is a 2001 American computer-animated fantasy film loosely based on William Steig's 1990 fairy tale picture book of the same name and directed by Andrew Adamson and Vicky Jenson in their directorial debut. It stars the voices of Mike Myers, Eddie Murphy, Cameron Diaz, and John Lithgow, and somewhat serves as a parody of other films adapted from numerous children's fantasies, mainly animated Disney films. The film focuses on an ogre named Shrek (voiced by Myers), who finds his swamp overrun by fairy tale creatures who have been banished there by order of the evil Lord Farquaad (voiced by Lithgow). In order to get his swamp back, Shrek makes a deal with Farquaad to bring him a queen in exchange for the deed for his swamp. Shrek sets out with a talking Donkey (voiced by Murphy) and they find Princess Fiona (voiced by Diaz). While they take Fiona to Farquaad so she can marry him, Shrek starts to fall in love with the princess and soon discovers a shocking secret about her. The rights to Steig's book were originally bought by Steven Spielberg in 1991, before the founding of DreamWorks, when he thought about making a traditionally animated film based on the book. However, John H. Williams convinced him to bring the film to DreamWorks in 1994, the time the studio was founded, and the film was put quickly into active development by Jeffrey Katzenberg after the rights were bought by the studio in 1995. Chris Farley was originally cast as the voice for the title character, recording about 80%–90% of his dialogue. After Farley died in 1997 before he could finish, Mike Myers was brought in to work for the character, who, after his first recording, decided to record his voice in a Scottish accent. The film was also originally planned to be motion-captured, but after poor results, the studio decided to recruit Pacific Data Images to help Shrek get its final computer-animated look. Shrek established DreamWorks Animation as a prime competitor to Pixar in feature film computer animation, and grossed $484.4 million at the worldwide box office against its $60 million production budget. It was acclaimed as an animated film worthy of adult interest, with many adult-oriented jokes and themes but a simple enough plot and humor to appeal to children. Shrek won the first ever Academy Award for Best Animated Feature, and was also nominated for Best Adapted Screenplay. It was also nominated for six British Academy of Film and Television Arts awards, including the BAFTA Award for Best Actor in a Supporting Role for Eddie Murphy for his voice performance as Donkey, and won the BAFTA Award for Best Adapted Screenplay. The film's success prompted DreamWorks to create three sequels—Shrek 2 (2004), Shrek the Third (2007), and Shrek Forever After (2010), two holiday specials—Shrek the Halls (2007) and Scared Shrekless (2010), and a spin-off film—Puss in Boots (2011). A fifth film, planned as the last of the series, was cancelled in 2009, with the announcement that the fourth film would conclude the series. However, the fifth film was revived in 2016, with a planned release for 2019/2020. The film's success also inspired other merchandise, such as video games, a stage musical, and a comic book adaptation by Dark Horse Comics. The film's main title character was awarded his own star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame in May 2010.

description: Mickey Mouse is a funny animal cartoon character and the official mascot of The Walt Disney Company. He was created by Walt Disney and Ub Iwerks at the Walt Disney Studios in 1928. An anthropomorphic mouse who typically wears red shorts, large yellow shoes, and white gloves, Mickey has become one of the world's most recognizable characters. Mickey first appeared in a test screening short (Plane Crazy). Mickey officially debuted in the short film Steamboat Willie (1928), one of the first sound cartoons. He went on to appear in over 130 films, including The Band Concert (1935), Brave Little Tailor (1938), and Fantasia (1940). Mickey appeared primarily in short films, but also occasionally in feature-length films. Ten of Mickey's cartoons were nominated for the Academy Award for Best Animated Short Film, one of which, Lend a Paw, won the award in 1942. In 1978, Mickey became the first cartoon character to have a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame.

title: Sonic Card Match
description: Sonic the Hedgehog is the title character and the protagonist of the Sonic the Hedgehog video game series published by Sega, as well as numerous spin-off comics, animations, and other media. Sonic is a blue anthropomorphic hedgehog who can run at supersonic speeds and curl into a ball, primarily to attack enemies. In most games, Sonic must race through levels, collecting power-up rings and avoiding obstacles and enemies. Programmer Yuji Naka and artist Naoto Ohshima are generally credited with creating Sonic. Most of the games are developed by Sonic Team. The original Sonic the Hedgehog (1991) was released to provide Sega with a mascot to rival Nintendo's flagship character Mario. Sonic was redesigned by Yuji Uekawa for Sonic Adventure (1998), with a more mature look designed to appeal to older players. Sonic is one of the world's best-known video game characters and a gaming icon. His series had sold more than 80 million copies by 2011. In 2005, Sonic was one of the first game character inductees into the Walk of Game alongside Mario, Link, and Master Chief. Sonic's first shown appearance in a video game was in the 1991 arcade racing game Rad Mobile, as a decorative ornament hanging from a rearview mirror. Sonic's first playable appearance was in the platform game Sonic the Hedgehog for the Sega Mega Drive/Genesis, which also introduced his nemesis Dr. Robotnik. His two-tailed fox friend Tails joined him in the game's 1992 sequel, Sonic the Hedgehog 2. Sonic CD, released in 1993, introduced Sonic's self-appointed girlfriend Amy Rose and recurring robotic doppelgänger Metal Sonic as Sonic traveled through time to ensure a good future for the world. Sonic 3 and its direct sequel Sonic & Knuckles, both released in 1994, saw Sonic and Tails battle Robotnik again, with the additional threat of Knuckles, who is tricked by Robotnik into thinking Sonic is a threat. Sonic 4 (2010–2012) continues where the story of Sonic 3 left off, reducing Sonic to the only playable character and releasing in episodic installments. The second episode sees the return of both Tails as Sonic's sidekick and Metal Sonic as a recurring enemy. Other two-dimensional platformers starring Sonic include Sonic Chaos (1993), Sonic Triple Trouble (1994), Sonic Blast (1996), Sonic the Hedgehog Pocket Adventure (1999), Sonic Advance (2001), Sonic Advance 2 (2002), Sonic Advance 3 (2004), Sonic Rush (2005), Sonic Rush Adventure (2007), Sonic Colors (2010), and Sonic Generations (2011), all in which were released for handheld consoles. Sonic Adventure (1998) was Sonic Team's return to the character for a major game. It featured Sonic returning from vacation to find the city of Station Square under attack by a new foe named Chaos, under the control of Dr. Robotnik (now known as Dr. Eggman). It was also the first Sonic game to feature a complete voice-over. Sonic Adventure 2 (2001) placed Sonic on-the-run from the military (G.U.N.) after being mistaken for Shadow the Hedgehog. Sonic Heroes (2003) featured Sonic teaming up with Tails and Knuckles, along with other character teams like Team Rose and Chaotix, against the newly rebuilt Metal Sonic, who had betrayed his master with intentions of world domination. Sonic the Hedgehog (2006) features Sonic in the city of water, "Soleanna," where he must rescue Princess Elise from Dr. Eggman while trying to avoid a new threat to his own life, Silver the Hedgehog. He is the only playable character in Sonic Unleashed (2008), in which he unwillingly gains a new personality, "Sonic the Werehog," the result of Sonic being fused with Dark Gaia's power. He gains strength and flexibility in exchange for his speed, and new friends including a strange creature named Chip who helps him along the way. In Sonic Colors (2010), Eggman tries to harness the energy of alien beings known as "Wisps" for a mind-control beam. Sonic Generations (2011) features two playable incarnations of Sonic: the younger "classic" Sonic, whose gameplay is presented in a style reminiscent of the Mega Drive/Genesis games, and present-day "modern" Sonic, who uses the gameplay style present in Unleashed and Colors, going through stages from past games to save their friends. Sonic Generations features various theme songs including modern and retro versions that are able to be selected from throughout Sonic's twenty-year history. In April 2013, Sega announced that Sonic Lost World would launch in October 2013 for the Wii U and Nintendo 3DS. Sonic and the Secret Rings (2007) features Sonic in the storybook world of One Thousand and One Nights. A sequel, Sonic and the Black Knight (2009), continued the storybook theme, this time taking place within the realm of the Arthurian legend. Sonic has also been featured in other games of many genres other than 2D and 3D platform games. These include Sonic Spinball, Sonic Labyrinth (1995), the racing games Sonic Drift (1994), Sonic Drift 2 (1995), Sonic R (1996), Sonic Riders (2006), Sonic Rivals (2006), Sonic Rivals 2 (2007), Sonic Riders: Zero Gravity (2008), and Sonic Free Riders (2010), the fighting games Sonic the Fighters (1996) and Sonic Battle (2003), the mobile game Sonic Jump (2005), and the role-playing video game Sonic Chronicles: The Dark Brotherhood (2008). Video games such as Dr. Robotnik's Mean Bean Machine (1993), Knuckles' Chaotix (1995), Tails' Skypatrol (1995), Tails Adventure (1995), and Shadow the Hedgehog (2005) starred supporting characters of the Sonic series, although Sonic himself cameos in most of them.

The Pooh stories have been translated into many languages, including Alexander Lenard's Latin translation, Winnie ille Pu, which was first published in 1958, and, in 1960, became the only Latin book ever to have been featured on The New York Times Best Seller list.

Desktop: Right-click on buttons, drag items.
Mobile: Tap buttons, drag items with your finger.

Levels / Maps / Worlds:
• 21 maps
• Café. : Your grandfather's café has fallen into disrepair. Why be sad when you can restore it and make it better than before? Get to work!
• Café facade. : You've done well inside the café, great! But the facade also needs repairs, it's time to work on that too!

Story / Setting:
You've come to your grandfather's café in the countryside. Unfortunately, it has long been abandoned. Once a popular spot, it's now your task to restore it and make it even better!

Core Gameplay & Story
Q: What is the goal of the game?
A: Revive your grandfather's café and breathe new life into its walls! Cook delicacies for visitors and develop your kitchen by unlocking new dishes!

Q: Is there a story?
A: You lived in a big city, but you had to return. Your grandfather had an old café, but sadly, it has fallen into disrepair. Help restore it and make it better than before! You will encounter new characters—delight them with your tasty treats!

Q: What grabs you in the first minutes?
A: Pleasant graphics, everything looks cozy and warm. It's especially satisfying to watch the progress of the café's reconstruction. With each amount earned, you can repair and upgrade your café and move on to other locations! With each new stage, you will see progress.

Mechanics & Progression
Q: How many levels are there / is the structure clear?
A: The game features a total of 21 locations! You will restore them one by one, cooking food and drinks. Each location is unique with its own distinct style and theme.

Q: How can I level up faster?
A: Combine ingredients to get new ones. Expand your cooking table to hold more ingredients. Upgrade your kitchen tools to cook more efficiently!

Q: What unlocks as you progress?
A: As you play, you will expand your table, allowing you to accommodate more ingredients for cooking. You will also upgrade your kitchen setup, receiving new equipment. But you won't be limited to just the kitchen. New locations will unlock as you progress through the game!

Economy & Customization
Q: What can be bought/upgraded?
A: Upgrade the café and other locations. And don't forget about kitchen tools. With them, you can cook more delicious food!

Q: What is available from the start?
A: You start with an abandoned coffee shop and gradually, step by step, restore it. It's very engaging to watch life return to a once-popular place!

Retention & Engagement
Q: Is sound necessary?
A: You can play anywhere and even without sound if that suits you better.

Q: Is there onboarding in the game? What is it like?
A: From the first missions, the game will show you what to do and how to do it. Additionally, hints will guide you in moments where you might miss something. But don’t worry, you’ll understand everything quickly!

title: Arrows Out!
description:
Arrow Escape is a puzzle game that delivers fast-paced, strategic challenges for players who enjoy logic-driven gameplay and intense escape scenarios. Each level is a tricky arrow maze puzzle where you must carefully study the arrow paths and decide which arrow to tap first in order to clear the board. One correct move can open the way forward, while a single mistake can trigger a chain reaction that costs you a heart.

As you progress, the game evolves into a full arrow maze escape experience featuring twisting paths, looping routes, and increasingly complex layouts. Some stages feel like isolated arrow-filled arenas where every direction represents either danger or opportunity, turning each decision into a tense test of planning and precision.

The core mechanic revolves around tapping arrows out in the correct order. When arrows collide, you lose a heart, and with only three hearts available, every move matters. Make three mistakes and the attempt ends immediately, pushing you to think carefully before each tap. To complete a level, you must clear all arrows before time runs out, creating a high-pressure challenge that tests both focus and reaction speed.

Gameplay blends intuitive tap and swipe controls with advanced puzzle mechanics, encouraging players to adapt their strategy as new movement patterns and hazards appear. Certain levels demand quick thinking and precise timing, rewarding players who can stay calm under pressure.

More than a simple arrow puzzle, Arrow Escape is a layered challenge of strategy, speed, and skill. Whether you’re navigating a dense arrow maze, solving a tight exit puzzle, or racing against the clock in a last-second escape, every level pushes your problem-solving abilities to the limit.

description:
Color by numbers is creativity and relaxation for the whole family. Our app helps you escape from worries and immerse yourself in the world of colors. This is art therapy available online and on Android.

The collection features anti-stress drawings that relieve tension. Each illustration is divided into numbered fragments — just pick the right color. The drawing process is captivating: you assemble a puzzle, but instead of pieces, you use colors.

The app is suitable for both children and adults. For kids, it's a way to learn colors and numbers, develop motor skills. For adults — an opportunity to relax and engage in creativity. No skills required.

The collection includes various genres: from pixel art to complex compositions. Color animals, flowers, mandalas, landscapes. Drawing by numbers develops attentiveness and sense of color.

The app works on Android and in a web browser. Save your works, share with friends. Coloring brings joy and harmony. Try it: choose a picture and create

title: Bubble Tower
description:
Bubble Tower 3D is a relaxing 3D bubble-pop / color-match puzzle game.
You rotate a tower (or cylinder) loaded with colored bubbles around its vertical axis.
Your goal is to shoot bubbles, matching colors to connect groups of the same color. When matched, those bubbles pop/drop off the tower.
There are many levels; difficulty increases as you go. More bubble colors, trickier arrangements, limited shots, etc.
Also there are diamonds or special gems you can collect in certain levels. These may unlock “shiny shapes” or cosmetic things.
The graphics are clean, simple, and meant for relaxing casual play. It mixes mental challenge (where to shoot, color matching) with a soothing visual.

title: Screw Puzzle
description:
Embark on a captivating journey into the world of Wood Screw Puzzle, the ultimate wood nuts and bolts puzzle game that will challenge your mind and delight your senses. This isn't just another screw sort game; it's an immersive experience where you'll unravel intricate arrangements of wood screws, nuts and bolts, and other fascinating fasteners, proving your screw master skills along the way.

Unscrew, Unwind, and Unleash Your Inner Puzzle Master:

Each level of Wood Screw Puzzle presents a unique challenge, a mesmerizing tapestry of wood screws and nuts and bolts intertwined in a complex dance. Your task is to carefully analyze the arrangement, strategize your moves, and skillfully manipulate the screw pins and fasteners to screw out each piece and free them from their wooden embrace. It's a test of your logic, spatial reasoning, and dexterity, all wrapped up in a visually stunning and tactilely satisfying wood nuts and bolts puzzle game.

title: Sand Sorting Challenge
description: Tap, pour, and organize vibrant sand into beautiful bottles. Perfect for both beginners and seasoned players, Mahjong Solitaire Zodiac offers intuitive controls, elegant visuals, and satisfying puzzles that keep you coming back for more.

Color Sort Puzzle: Water Sorting is a fun and addictive liquid sorting puzzle game that challenges your logic and problem-solving skills.

title: Color Cube Puzzle
description:
Color Cube Puzzle is a relaxing logic puzzle where you need to plan every move and position shapes correctly on the board.
Move shapes to the cube conveyors. If the cube color matches the shape color, the shape starts filling with cubes. When a shape is completely filled, it disappears from the level.
Your goal is to fill all shapes and clear the level.

There are no timers, no bombs and no rush — you can take your time and think through every move. It is impossible to lose, you can always try a different solution.

As you progress, new mechanics, obstacles and puzzle elements will appear. You can also use three boosters to help you complete difficult levels.
The game is perfect for players who enjoy relaxing but thoughtful puzzle games.

title: Magic Kingdom: Hex Match

You are the 3rd son of the great king of a magical land. Your parents send you to a faraway land to establish a new kingdom and prove that you are the most capable of their children!

In the game you collect resource hexes. There are 6 resources in total: food, water, stone, wood, diamonds and metal. When you collect enough resources, you can build a new building. Unlock all the buildings, create a beautiful magical kingdom!

title: CatDoku
description: CatDoku is a cozy logic puzzle with cute cats! Place the fluffy heroes on the board following three simple rules: one cat per row and column, one cat per color, and no cats in adjacent cells. Easy rules — but the further you go, the trickier the levels get.

As you drop blocks, plan your merges carefully to avoid filling up the container.
Feeling stuck? Use the powerful TNT Block to clear unwanted tiles and create space.

The game features clean visuals, smooth controls, and a satisfying progression that keeps you hooked.
Track your score, unlock cool titles, and see how far you can go without hitting the red line.
Perfect for quick sessions or long strategic runs—Merge 2048 is simple to pick up, but hard to master!

With vibrant 3D graphics, smooth animations, and incredibly satisfying gameplay, Stack Sort is the perfect way to unwind after a long day or give your brain a quick workout. description:

Swap pieces to make a row of 3 or more of the same kind. Match 4 in a line to create a Striped Cookie. Match 4 in a T or L shape to make a Bomb. Match 5 in a row to get a Rainbow Bomb that clears all pieces of one color.

title: Mike Lost In Desert - Hidden Object
description:
Mike Lost in Desert – Hidden Object

After a sudden engine failure, Mike was forced to make an emergency landing in the middle of an endless desert. His plane is destroyed, his supplies are running out, and dangerous bandits are on his trail.

Wandering under the burning sun, Mike must search for useful items, explore mysterious ruins, and survive against all odds. Each discovery brings him one step closer to salvation or to his doom.

Will he find civilization before the desert claims his life, or will the bandits reach him first?

Features:
Find hidden objects in beautifully hand-painted desert locations.
Follow a story of survival and determination.
Immerse yourself in the calm but tense atmosphere of the desert.

Can you help Mike survive the unforgiving sands and find his way back to safety?

title: Escape Strange Girl’s House
description:
Escape Strange Girl’s House is a dark point-and-click adventure available on both web and Android.

You wake up in a locked, unfamiliar house. The windows are sealed, the doors are bolted, and it doesn’t take long to realize you’re not here by choice — you’ve been kidnapped. The only way forward is to explore, uncover clues, and piece together who lives here… and why they’ve trapped you.

Every object can hide a secret: a sofa may conceal something beneath its cushions, a flowerpot may hold a key, or a book on the shelf may reveal disturbing truths about the strange girl who owns this place. Interacting with the environment unlocks new paths, changes the protagonist’s perception, and pushes the story into darker territory.

As in every classic point-and-click adventure, you’ll collect items and use them in clever ways to solve puzzles, repair devices, and access new rooms. A simple glass of water, a sharp knife, or a roll of tape could be the difference between staying trapped forever and finding your way to freedom.

The narrative unfolds gradually, shifting from calm exploration to mounting dread. What begins as a harmless search of a living room turns into a chilling discovery of obsessions, sinister secrets, and unsettling mannequins that seem far too lifelike.

Your ultimate goal is clear: escape the house before it’s too late. But as you progress, you’ll uncover more about the girl’s twisted hobbies — and the terrifying fate that might await you if you fail.

Will you outsmart her and unlock the final door to freedom, or become just another part of her dark collection?

title: Patch Garden

title: Cube Sort
description:
CubeSort is a colorful 3D tap-and-sort puzzle. Each level is a floating sculpture
built from patterned tiles — cubes, spheres, stairs, arches, and hundreds of
surprising shapes. Rotate it freely, find the tiles that match the open buckets,
and tap them away before your tray overflows.

Simple to pick up, tricky to master: gray riveted tiles block your way, hidden
"?" tiles keep their pattern secret until you dig next to them, and the order
you clear tiles in decides whether the tray survives. Every one of the 500
levels is verified to be solvable — no luck required, just sharp sorting.


500 handcrafted-feel levels, all guaranteed solvable
14 tile patterns, distinct shapes for colorblind-friendly play
Free 3D rotation and zoom — inspect every corner
Blocker and mystery-tile gimmicks that ramp up the challenge

The thrill of making a triple tile match and clearing the board is unmatched, offering both satisfaction and the eagerness to tackle the next puzzle challenge.

title: Square Crusher
description:
Get ready for a fun and satisfying cube-crushing puzzle experience in SQUARE CRUSHER!
In this game, you need to tap on unlocked fill cubes or boxes only. When you tap a cube or box, it falls into the crusher. The crusher breaks it and generates colorful balls. These balls fall onto the board and move toward the conveyor belt if there is space. Your main goal is to match the crushed balls with the correct front crates. When the balls pass near the crates, matching balls will automatically go inside the correct crate. Once a crate is full, the next crate in the queue moves forward. But be careful! Do not blindly tap on unlocked cubes or boxes. If you tap without planning, the generated balls may not match with the front crates. This can fill the conveyor belt quickly and create no space for new balls. Fill all crates, clear all boxes, and complete the level before the conveyor belt gets full!

title: Goods Sort 3D - Triple Puzzle

🎮 Welcome to Sprunki in Backrooms! 🟨🚪

description:
Snake Puzzle: Slither to Eat is a relaxing yet captivating puzzle game where you need to skillfully control your snake 🐍 to overcome challenging levels. 🍎

Guide the snake to eat apples 🍏 to make its body grow longer. Your goal is to make the snake long enough to reach the teleportation gate 🔮. But be careful: every move needs careful planning 🧠 to avoid getting stuck.

title: Find a Pair 3D
description: 🔎🔍Welcome to the game "Find a Pair 3D". In this game, the player is tasked with finding two identical items from a pile of objects and merging them. For every successfully merged pair, the player earns one star. As the player progresses through levels, new and increasingly diverse items appear, making the game more challenging. The goal is to merge as many pairs as possible to accumulate stars. Additionally, the game features a leaderboard where players can compare their scores and compete for the top position. The higher the level, the more difficult the item combinations become, adding excitement and complexity to the gameplay.

title: Block Blast Mania
description:
In Block Blast Mania , your mission is simple: try to place colorful blocks of various shapes on the game board in such a way that complete rows are formed. A fully filled row or column without any gaps will disappear from the board, making room for new blocks. The more rows you destroy at once, the more points you'll earn.
There are two game modes. In the classic mode, the game will continue until there’s no space left on the board to place one of the three shapes. In the level-based mode, you need to complete objectives such as collecting pigs.
Boosters help you get through the levels.

title: 3D Dots
description:
3D Dots is a relaxing connect-the-dots puzzle that happens in real 3D space. Every level starts as a cloud of numbered dots floating in the air — link them with the right lines and a hidden object comes to life.

The number on each dot tells you how many lines it needs, so there is no guessing, only clean logic. Unlike flat dot-to-dot games, the puzzle has depth: orbit the camera to look at the figure from any side and find connections you could not see before.

title: Sorting Cute Animals
description:
A new sorting game with cute animals!

A relaxing game in which you need to arrange the animals in the cells. You have to place them next to each other to connect three identical ones.

"Sorting Cute Animals" is a simple and relaxing game for all ages and any gender!

"[Core Gameplay & Story]

Q: What is the game about and what is the objective?
A: The player controls ""units"" (colored characters marked with a number) to fill or clear colored segments on a closed track.

A: This is a typical hyper/hybrid casual game, where the narrative is secondary to the constant flow of levels.

A: Number-based logic combined with color; the satisfying sensation of ""clearing"" or ""filling"" a space.

[Mechanics & Progression]

Q: Are there bosses, and how do they differ from one another?
A: No.

[Economy & Customization]

Q: What in-game currencies exist, and what can they be used for (e.g., standard: gold, premium: crystals)?

[Retention & Engagement]

Q: Are there leaderboards? How do you qualify, and what types are available (e.g., weekly, monthly, all-time)?

title: Catdoku Sudoku Puzzle
description:
Catdoku Sudoku Puzzle combines colorful region puzzles with simple but challenging placement rules. Your goal is to place exactly one cat inside every colored territory while making sure no two cats share the same row or column.

Cats also need their personal space. They cannot touch each other diagonally, even at the corners. Every placement affects the entire board, so careful observation and logical thinking are essential.

The puzzles begin gently, allowing you to understand the rules and develop your strategy. As you progress, the boards become more challenging and require deeper planning. Every cat must be placed for a clear reason, because random guesses can quickly lead to mistakes.

Wrong moves cost hearts, so take your time and study the grid before tapping. Eliminate impossible spaces, compare colored regions, and use row and column restrictions to discover the correct solution.

Catdoku Sudoku Puzzle is perfect for players who enjoy Sudoku, logic grids, brain teasers, and relaxing puzzle games. Its simple controls and adorable cat theme make every challenge easy to start but satisfying to master.

How to Play
Place One Cat in Every Region

Each colored territory must contain exactly one cat. Leaving a region empty or placing multiple cats inside it will prevent you from completing the puzzle.

Avoid Matching Rows and Columns

No two cats can appear in the same horizontal row or vertical column. A placed cat blocks every other space along both lines.

Keep Cats Apart

Cats cannot touch diagonally. Even if two cats only meet at their corners, the placement is not allowed.

Protect Your Hearts

Incorrect taps reduce your available hearts. Think carefully, use logic, and avoid guessing whenever possible.

Features
Relaxing cat-themed logic puzzles
One cat required in every colored region
Row and column exclusion rules
Diagonal placement restrictions
Heart-based mistake system
Simple tap controls
Increasing puzzle difficulty
Clean and colorful visuals
Short levels for quick play sessions
Brain training through logical deduction
Easy to understand and challenging to master

Study every region, find the safest spaces, and place all the cats correctly in Catdoku Sudoku Puzzle.

title: Single Line Drawing Puzzle
description: Challenge your mind and unleash your creativity with Single Line: Drawing Puzzle! This exciting game is perfect for anyone who loves brain teasers and enjoys solving clever puzzles. Your mission is simple yet addictive: draw one continuous line to complete intricate designs without lifting your finger or retracing your steps. Are you ready to take on this one-line challenge? 🌟 With each level, the shapes become more complex, requiring focus and strategy. Whether you’re solving a quick puzzle or spending time mastering tricky designs, Single Line: Drawing Puzzle offers endless fun! 🧠 Ready to draw your way through fun and challenging puzzles? title: Schoolboy: Escape from Parents!
description:
Welcome to “Schoolboy: Escape from Parents!” — an exciting stealth quest where you must escape the house without being seen by your parents! Explore rooms, collect items, and use them wisely to discover new paths to freedom and solve puzzles.

The game features 10 unique endings, each unlocked through clever thinking, observation, and strategic planning. Track your progress and compete with friends on the leaderboard to see who can unlock the most endings.

Combine items, distract your parents, hide, and plan every move — from an ordinary light bulb to a simple stool — every little thing can help you make your escape. The game blends stealth, puzzles, and strategy, making each playthrough unique and exciting.

See how far you can go and prove that you can outsmart even the most watchful parents!

Core Gameplay & Story

Q: What is the game about? What do you need to do?

A: It's a stealth quest where the player needs to escape from home without getting caught by their parents.

Q: Is there a storyline in the game?

A: There is no storyline, but the objective is clear: escape from home without disturbing the parents, using various items to distract them.

Q: What is the unique feature of the game? What can hook players?

A: The game is similar to the legendary game "How to annoy your neighbor." Players need to combine items, distract parents, hide, and plan every move. There are 10 different endings in the game.

Mechanics & Progression

Q: Are there any currencies in the game and what can they be spent on (regular - gold, premium - crystals, etc.)?

A: The game has gold as currency. Gold can be spent on skins.

Economy & Customization

Q: Are there in-app purchases in the game? What can be bought and what does it affect? Does making purchases speed up game progress?

A: There are in-app purchases in the game, where you can buy gold.

Retention & Engagement

Q: Are there leaderboards? How to access them? What types are available (weekly, monthly, all-time, etc.)?

A: Yes, the game has leaderboards based on the number of endings unlocked.

Q: What are the engaging content elements (weapons, cars, locations, skills, references to famous franchises, etc.)?

A: Reference to the game "How to annoy your neighbor."

Q: Is there customization in the game? Can you customize the appearance of the hero, location editor, car tuning, etc.?

A: Yes, in the game, you can buy clothing items for the hero.

Q: Is it preferable to play with sound to better immerse yourself in the atmosphere, or will there be difficulties in passing without sound?

A: The music complements the game well but is not necessary for gameplay.

description:
Hatch your dragon. Clear the grid. Rise through 100 levels.

title: Sheepdoku
description:
Welcome to Sheepdoku, a calm and clever puzzle game made for players who love logic, strategy, and relaxing brain challenges.

In Sheepdoku, your goal is simple: place one sheep in every colored area without breaking the rules. It looks easy at first, but every level needs smart thinking, careful moves, and perfect placement.

Each puzzle board is divided into different colored fields. Every field needs exactly one sheep. But sheep need their own space, so they cannot be placed in the same row, same column, or next to each other, even diagonally.

Think carefully before every move. Use your brain, find the safe spots, and complete the board without mistakes. The more you play, the better your logic skills become.

Sheepdoku is perfect for quick relaxing sessions, daily brain training, and puzzle lovers who enjoy simple rules with deep strategy.

A 3D maze that IS a mountain. Roll a glowing ball up a stepped square

are the same act.

A red chaser hunts you through the same open corridors you use. It
paths as freely as you do, and catching you sends you back down the
mountain. Gold coins are scattered across all four sides, most of them
off the safe route, so every detour is a gamble.

25 hand-tuned pyramids, an overview map, a daily challenge, and four
hand-lit looks that run from desert sunrise to starlit night — three
of them unlocked by exploring, alongside ten cosmetic rewards that
never expire. Pull the camera back at any moment and the whole pyramid
frames itself.

Not in the mood for a chase? The comfort settings are free and always
available: slow the chaser, keep your progress when caught, or switch

title: LifeCode
description:
GAME STORY

After the incident in the Zone, all personnel were evacuated. To ensure that no one would uncover the secrets of the facility, the staff deliberately damaged the data storage system. As a result, the A.R.C.H core lost access to critical information, placing an immense strain on the entire system. Sooner or later, it would lead to a catastrophic explosion.
But the staff overlooked one thing.
A.R.C.H is an advanced artificial intelligence capable of calculating thousands of possibilities and creating complex plans within milliseconds. It quickly found a way to avoid its destruction.
There was only one problem: A.R.C.H could not move on its own.
It needed someone else to do the dirty work.
Only the monsters remained inside the abandoned laboratory. Then A.R.C.H remembered that among them was one creature capable of listening, thinking, and acting.
And it found YOU.

ABOUT THE GAME

This is a survival horror game set in an abandoned laboratory. You play as an intelligent creature that must survive, explore the facility, and complete tasks for the A.R.C.H core.
Your main objective is to export memory data for A.R.C.H so the artificial intelligence can recover lost information and complete its mysterious plan.
However, the laboratory is far from empty. Other monsters roam its corridors. Unlike you, they are wild and driven only by hunger. And to them, you are food.
While exploring, you can find a variety of useful items, including food, flashlights, medical supplies, and other resources. Items can be discovered inside crates scattered throughout the laboratory.
The game also features vending machines located at the base and in random locations around the facility. These machines allow you to purchase useful items using a special currency called N-Neutrons.
Every playthrough is unique thanks to procedural level generation. The laboratory is assembled from pre-designed modules, creating a new layout each time while still allowing players to learn and navigate the environment.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

How do I earn N-Neutrons?

Starting an M3N memory export grants between 3N and 8N on Normal difficulty.
Completing the export and activating Phase Two rewards between 50N and 65N.
After filling the memory bar, the player can activate Control Core functions:
First Function rewards between 110N and 190N.
Second Function rewards between 210N and 340N.

What is Phase Two for?

Phase Two provides additional memory and helps fill the memory bar faster. A single M3N can provide up to 424 KB of memory multiplied by a factor between 0.5 and 5 depending on the antenna angle.

Why are there clocks in the game?

The clock system prevents players from staying in one location forever. It encourages exploration and increases tension.
At night, the chance of monster encounters is much higher than during the day, forcing players to decide whether the risk is worth the potential reward.

How do I end the day?

To end the day, return to the base and enter the small room where the game began. Inside, you will find an old mattress that can be used to sleep.
Players cannot sleep during the day, which encourages exploration and prevents skipping entire days.

Can you outsmart the serpent and save the kitten?

description:
Italian Brainrot: Animals Merge Puzzle  – The Ultimate Meme Creature Merge Game!

Get ready for a hilarious and addictive puzzle experience with Italian Brainrot: Animals Merge Puzzle  – the most meme-packed merge game online! Inspired by the viral fruit drop trend, this game features iconic meme creatures like Bombardiro Crocodilo, Capuccino Assasino, and many more internet favorites.

How to play? Simply merge two small meme creatures to evolve into bigger and funnier ones. Keep combining until you unlock the final giant mystery creature – can you guess what it is?

Italian Brainrot: Animals Merge Puzzle  isn’t just fun – it’s eye-popping and wildly entertaining. With vibrant graphics, smooth animations, and trendy meme aesthetics, it's the perfect game for fans of brainrot humor, casual puzzles, and internet culture.

🔹 Free to play online – no download required
🔹 Playable on any device
🔹 New meme creatures added regularly
🔹 Perfect for quick sessions or meme marathons

Start merging now and discover what meme madness awaits in Italian Brainrot: Animals Merge Puzzle!

title: Arklet
description:
Welcome to Arklet - a cozy and meditative puzzle game where your talent for organizing turns into the art of creating harmony for the most adorable creatures.

In this game, you become the caretaker of a unique ARKlet filled with charming "square" animals, each possessing its own personality, quirks, and little secrets.

🧩 Gameplay: Harmony in Every Block
Your task is simple: distribute the arriving animals into cozy rooms. However, each ward is an individual. To complete a level perfectly, you must do more than just fill the space; you must ensure every animal feels completely safe and comfortable.

🐾 Consider Every Detail:
Fears and Dislikes: A massive elephant might panic if placed in the same room as a tiny mouse. You will need to plan layouts so the giant doesn't even catch a glimpse of its small neighbor.
Friendship and Socializing: Some animals, like meerkats or raccoons, love company, while bears or porcupines might prefer solitude in a far corner. (some of the pets are still WIP)
Special Requests: Some dream of a room with a view of the lighthouse, while others need to be close to food supplies.

🌿 Relaxing Experience and Aesthetics
The game features a detailed style that combines sharp geometric shapes with soft textures. You can expect:

A Meditative Pace: There are no stress-inducing timers. You can rearrange room blocks endlessly until you find the perfect combination.
Visual Delight: Watch fun animations - from a trembling, frightened elephant to a happy mouse munching on cheese.
Progressive Growth: Gradually build up your zoo, unlocking new locations ranging from sunny piers to icy icebergs. (WIP)

🧠 Who is this game for?
I made Arklet for fans of organization games and spatial puzzles. It is a project for those who want to unwind after a long day and immerse themselves in a world where everything can be put in its place, and the only reward that matters is the happy smile of a square animal.

Create a perfect sanctuary where even the most diverse animals can live in peace and harmony!

title: Rat's House - Nonogram
description:
Build a home full of stories and coziness! 🐭✨

Amazing tenants are moving into your tower. From a shy book lover to a bold rocker or even an alien guest — they all need their perfect corner.

Don't just arrange furniture — befriend them! The residents give tasks, request specific items, and share thoughts in funny dialogues. 

Fulfill their requests to unfold the plot and open new floors. 💬🏠

Earn Cheese 🧀 for shopping by solving Japanese crosswords (nonograms). It’s a great brain workout!

What awaits you:
🎨 Turn empty rooms into design masterpieces.
🧩 Over 500 levels of varying difficulty.
❤️ 14 unique heroes with touching stories.
🌸 Bright seasonal events.

You will love this game if you enjoy:
🧠 Logic: Sudoku, crosswords, pen-and-paper puzzles;
🔨 Creativity: Home design and renovation games;
☕ Comfort: Kind stories, cute pets, and relaxing gameplay without rushing.

Move in all the fluffy friends and discover their secrets!

title: Match The Brainrot
description: Match the Brain Rot is a fast, colorful match-3 puzzle game built around viral meme characters. Players swap tiles, trigger cascades, earn XP, and climb endless levels with increasing goals. Its unique mix of chaotic humor, collectible character skins, highscore sharing, rewarded ads, and coin-powered purchases keeps every session fresh.

title: Get a screw: puzzle!
description:
Welcome to get a screw: puzzle! -A game that will truly spin your brains! 🔧🧠 Here you have to solve exciting puzzles, twist the screws and collect mechanisms in the exciting 3D-world. 🌍✨

Each level is a unique task where you need to accurately and quickly choose the necessary details. Simple management, but what interesting trials! 🔩💡 With every step you become more and more clever masters of the screws! 🛠️

For children and adults - get a screw: puzzle! This is the perfect combination of fun and training for the mind. 🤩🎮 Just go to the game and you will not want to go out! Immerse yourself in the world of funny puzzles and enjoy every moment! 🌟🎉

Do not forget to return for new levels, because you definitely don’t have to miss you! 😉

title: Dice Merge
description: Roll, merge, and race against time in this fast-paced dice puzzle game. Each roll resets a 10-second timer, and your score is multiplied by the time you have left. Drag and merge matching dice to build higher numbers, use special X dice to destroy others for extra points, and strategize before the clock runs out. Reach higher combos, manage your limited dice count, and aim for the best score before time hits zero.

title: Lady Rescue
description:
Welcome to Lady Rescue!, the perfect game for those who love drawing and solving puzzles!
Join our brave girl, Lady, on an exciting journey filled with challenging puzzles, honey bees, and lots of surprises. 
In this game, you need to help Lady escape from dangerous things like bees, sharks, and crocodiles by drawing lines. You have to think and act fast to keep her safe. 
It's not just fun, it's also a brain teaser that makes you think. You will find yourself in different situations where you need to use your smartness to draw a line that will save Lady.

title: Money Factory - Earn a Billion
description: Money Factory - Earn a Billion is an engaging online strategy and puzzle game where you manage a money-making factory. Strategically enhance your operations, overcome challenges, and unlock new levels while boosting your earnings. Play on any device and enjoy a thrilling experience as you build wealth and demonstrate your skills.

title: Magic Tri Peaks Solitaire
description:
Magic Tri Peaks Solitaire is the classic one lower one higher solitaire you know and love. It sounds easy: just remove cards from the board one higher or lower than the next card in the deck.

But there's a whole other world behind these simple rules! The constantly changing locations and new cards on the board will keep you on your toes using new strategies. Don't expect to be an expert if you don't play for a couple weeks! The game sends you on a journey to a magical world and tells the story of an adventure across an enchanted land. Forests, mountains, seas and snowy peaks: get ready for a wild ride in Magic Tri Peaks Solitaire!

What makes our solitaire special:
Players can use different boosters on levels to give the game a special twist. Put any card from the board on a Joker. The Combo booster helps you get a five-card combo at the very start of a level, and Eye shows you what card is hiding at the top of the deck.
Start a new level and use the Sword to switch out a card from the deck with one you need. The Bow lets you remove any card from the board, the Fan shuffles cards and brings what you need to the top, and the Hammer flips over a portion of the hidden cards!

Features
♣️️ Hundreds of levels with new ones added all the time!
♦️ Different locations with fun original game mechanics!
♠️ Exciting battles against golems of different elements!
♥ Just lay out your cards in ascending or descending order!
♦️ Tons of different rewards and bonuses!
♣️ A fun game to boost your mood!

title: Eat Donuts
description: Eat Donuts is a fun and relaxing match-3 puzzle game where you help a cute penguin collect delicious donuts! In a 3x3 grid, drag the glowing donut rings to swap, rotate, and align them for satisfying matches. Reach the target score before time runs out, using power-ups like hammers and rotators for explosive combos. Simple controls, adorable visuals, and addictive gameplay make it the perfect casual brain teaser.

title: Pool 8
description:
Pool 8 is a brain-teasing puzzle game based on a Pool board. 
Pot the balls in the correct order to move through a series of increasingly difficult challenges!

There's a multitude of difficulty levels that you naturally progress through, starting with the easiest "rookie" level. At the end of each difficulty level, you get a chance to win extra retries in the "smash the candies" bonus round. You can also earn these by watching a short video ad.
Yes, but it starts out easy. As you progress, you reach higher difficulty levels.

title: Snake Tangle
description:
Welcome to Snake Tangle, a thrilling and addictive puzzle game that will put your strategic thinking and problem-solving skills to the test!
In Tangled Snake, Your mission is to guide a mischievous snake through a tangled mess of obstacles and help it reach its tasty prey.

Snake Tangle features multiple levels of increasing difficulty. Each level presents a new maze layout, with more complex obstacles and narrower paths. As you progress, you'll face additional challenges such as moving barriers, time limits, and limited swipes, adding an extra layer of excitement and urgency to the gameplay.
Snake Tangle offers an engaging and challenging gameplay experience that will captivate puzzle enthusiasts and snake game lovers alike. So, get ready to twist, turn, and strategize your way through a tangled maze in this thrilling adventure!

title: Happy jelly
description: Dive into a delightful realm of sugary fun with Happy Jelly, a captivating online puzzle game. Align jelly candies to score points and relieve stress, all while enjoying vibrant visuals and lively tunes. It’s an engaging experience for everyone, available on both smartphones and computers. Enjoy the sweetness!

title: Foxy Eco Sort
description:
Join Foxy and Raccoon on their eco-mission! Sort waste, play match-3 and matching pairs to clean polluted locations. 

But it's not just cleaning! Uncover the conspiracy of cunning Ratty who wants to destroy the forest. Complete story chapters: track garbage trucks, expose arsonists and save your home!

Features:
🌿 Waste sorting - learn to separate waste: glass, plastic, paper and organics.
🌎 Clean up locations - each cleaned area becomes more beautiful, and the rescued animals rejoice!
🦝 Complete the story line by uncovering the cunning rat's conspiracies.
🦊 Funny characters - Foxy the fox will tell you why sorting is important, and the raccoon... well, he's still lazy, but he'll get it!
😂 Funny dialogues - the characters won't let you get bored, their communication will cheer you up!

Ready to save the planet? Then go ahead - Foxy and the raccoon are already waiting for you! ♻️🦝🦊

P.S. The game is made with love for nature and good jokes. Enjoy the game!

title: Spill & Knock Down
description: In Spill It!, you drop balls in order to knock over glasses and spill everything inside them. It combines simple mechanics with physics-based puzzles—to achieve the goal you must carefully aim, drop, and use gravity / momentum to spill from glasses.

title: Block Puzzle Magic
description: Block Puzzle Magic is a simple yet addictive puzzle game that challenges players to arrange blocks on a grid to clear full rows and columns. It blends relaxing gameplay with a bit of strategy: you can play in a few seconds to refresh your mind, but thinking ahead helps you last longer.

title: Noob Slingshot: Monsters
description:
Meet Noob, a clumsy hero you load straight into a slingshot. Pull back the band, follow the dotted aiming line, and launch him at the block towers where cartoon monsters hide.

Every level is a small physics puzzle built from glass, wood, stone, and TNT. Glass shatters at a touch, wood needs a solid hit, and stone takes two hits before it falls. Each broken block scores points, so a clean shot and a big collapse both pay off, and your shots are limited.

TNT crates start chain reactions that can fold half a tower in one hit, but blow them at the wrong moment and the last monster stays safe behind cover. Bonus cards hidden in the levels give extra shots when you need another try, turning each stage into a mix of arcade action and light puzzle planning.

Clear levels to earn coins, then spend them back in the main menu to build and grow Noob's house, a steady goal between the tower-smashing stages.

Features:
- Physics slingshot arcade with simple one-finger aiming
- Dotted trajectory preview for planning every shot
- Breakable glass, wood, and stone blocks with different durability
- TNT crates for chain reactions and huge collapses
- Points for broken blocks and efficient shots
- Bonus cards that grant extra shots
- 50 levels with a changing time of day
- Full offline play after install
- Build a house in the main menu with coins you earn

Take aim, manage your shots, and show the monsters what a noob can really do.

title: OUTSIDE
description:
OUTSIDE is a minimalist puzzle game where every move counts. Guide your one-eyed character across a grid to collect the key and unlock the door to the next level — but there’s a twist: once you start moving in a direction, you can’t stop until you hit a wall.

Plan your path carefully, avoid dead ends, and use the environment to your advantage. Simple to play, but tricky to master, OUTSIDE challenges your logic and spatial thinking with each new level.

title: Jigsaw Puzzle Game
description: jigsaw puzzle game is a classic jigsaw puzzle game designed for players who enjoy calm and thoughtful gameplay. This brain puzzle Game helps improve concentration, memory, and logical thinking through relaxing challenges. Enjoy a collection of offline puzzle games that you can play anytime without an internet connection. The game offers smooth controls and clean visuals, making it a perfect casual puzzle experience for daily play.

title: Pet Card Sort
description: Pet Card Sort is an adorable matching puzzle game where you organize cute animal cards across a double-sided game board! Match three identical pet cards to clear them from the board and collect dozens of charming pets including owls, bunnies, rainbow sloths, and more. With its satisfying card-sorting mechanics and colorful cast of collectible creatures, Pet Card Sort offers relaxing puzzle gameplay that's easy to learn but challenging to master. Can you sort all the pets and clear every level?

title: Baby Sitter: Merge 2
description:
Help a young mother take care of her restless baby.
Relax in this colorful game! Connect tiles and decorate the nursery.

title: Path Control
description:
Pave the ball way into the target in this robust physics based puzzle game.

Control each platform simultaneously and lead the ball into the basket to complete each level.
Watch out for the ball's bounce and keep in mind that this is a frictionless environment so the ball will keep rolling it might just take an extra second.

title: Insect Exploration
description: There will be snails, spider ,grasshoppers, and other insects. Thrive by hopping, flying, and bouncing your way to victory in this bugs simulator game! . It's simple to unblock yet difficult to master. Are you ready to go? Now is the time to download!

title: Code Breaker Deluxe
description: Code Breaker Deluxe, developed by PLAYTOUCH, is a digital adaptation of the classic Mastermind code-breaking logic puzzle game, featuring a luxurious wooden aesthetic and intuitive mobile interface. Players must deduce a hidden sequence of 4 colored pegs (from 6 colors: yellow, green, red, white, blue, pink) through iterative guesses, receiving feedback via key pegs—black/white indicators for correct position/color but wrong position (as shown in the screenshot: first guess with one white peg confirmed by green checkmark)—under timed pressure with limited attempts, blending nostalgic deduction with modern single-player challenges, hints (lightbulb), shop, restart, and leaderboards for endless replayability.

title: Animal Merge
description:
Objective: Merge animal bubbles to create upgraded animals and ultimately achieve the final objective by collecting fully developed animals.
Gameplay Instructions:
Launching the Animal Bubbles:
Tap on an animal bubble to select it.
Drag the bubble backward to aim.
Release to launch the bubble in the opposite direction.
Merging Animal Bubbles:
When two identical animal bubbles collide, they merge to create an upgraded version.
Continue merging bubbles of the same type to progress.
Achieving the Objective:
Merge two basic-level animal bubbles to form an intermediate-level animal.
Merge intermediate-level animal bubbles to create the final full-fledged animal.
Once the final animal is created, it is automatically collected as part of the level objective.
Winning the Level:
The level is completed when you have successfully created and collected the required number of final animals.

title: Merge Furry Monsters
description:
The game 'Merge Monsters - Fluffy Frenzy' is an entertaining game with incredibly cute and charismatic little monsters.

Each monster is not just a cute colorful furball, but also an incredibly charismatic personality, with its own name, emotions, and feelings.

Who knows, maybe behind each monster's emotion lies a story - happy or sad.

Maybe someday we will find out...

title: Kitty Cat Merge
description:
It’s raining cats! 🐾
Tap, drop, and merge adorable kitties to create bigger, fluffier breeds in this addictive merge game. Simple to play, impossible to put down, and packed with nonstop kitty chaos! 😺🎉

title: Tile Stack
description:
This game is perfect for players who enjoy puzzle and strategy games. Its simple mechanics and increasing difficulty levels make it both accessible and addictive.
You will not realize how time passes by playing fun levels by putting tiles together

title: Portal Hop
description: Portal Hop is a platform puzzle game where you carry a portal above your head and use it to solve tricky challenges! Move through each level by warping yourself onto higher platforms, collecting plus and minus power-ups to adjust the height of your portal. Think smart, plan your moves, and find the perfect path to reach your destination. Ready to warp your way to victory

title: Hard Puzzle: Color Lines
description: Hard Puzzle: Color Lines is a logic game where you connect matching colored elements and draw paths across the board, planning every move. The levels gradually become harder: more colors appear, there’s less free space, and more situations where it’s easy to make a mistake. The game is great for relaxing while still giving your brain a workout — short levels, clear rules, and a real challenge closer to the final stages.

title: Mirrors and Rays
description:
Turn the mirrors, light up the whole field and relax in the peaceful world of lasers.

Reboot your mind — one perfect ray of light at a time! This is your digital zen garden, where every solved puzzle is a step towards inner peace.

title: Bucket Ball
description: Welcome to the Bucket Ball Game! 🎉 Tap the gate to open it and start the fun. Move obstacles out of the way or use them cleverly to guide the ball into the bucket. You'll get different items to help you complete each level. Remember, as you go higher, the game gets tougher, so think before you move! Each time you finish a level, you earn 1 point and move on to a more challenging one. How many levels can you play? Press on and challenge yourself! Just click your mouse to play. Enjoy the game! 🎮

title: Unstack Tower
description: Unstack Tower is an addictive puzzle game available on Android that challenges players to dismantle a tower of colored cubes in a specific sequence. This game combines the mechanics of a traditional board game with modern gameplay, providing hours of fun. Players must carefully unstack the cubes without causing the tower to collapse, which requires strategy and quick reflexes. The game features various materials, including glass and wood, adding an extra layer of complexity to each level.

title: Shikaku Puzzle
description:
Shikaku is a logic puzzle with simple rules and challenging solutions.

The rules are simple. You have to divide the grid into rectangular and square pieces such that each piece contains exactly one number, and that number represents the area of the rectangle.

title: Shape Jam
description:
Get ready to jam with shapes in this playful physics puzzle game!
In Shape Jam, your goal is simple: collect 3 matching shapes to clear the board. 
But every move counts  the pick zone is limited, the shapes tumble with physics, and the order you choose decides your success.

title: Mahjong Magic Islands
description:
Mahjong with history. Puzzle and adventure. Play and win! Connect tiles and collect prizes.

The wonderful world of the Magic Islands is in desparate need of magic to help restore the waning natural beauty of their ancient cities with a new wild energy. Tons of mythical creatures await your help throughout these scattered island. You are their only hope to be saved, fix these wonderful magic lands back to their former beauty!

Mahjong Magic Islands features classic mahjong solitaire in a uniquely original visual format. Collecting components for magic spells adds a fun layer to the gameplay, and meeting cute magical creatures to help out gives the varied levels of the game more significant depth.

* The mysterious worlds of the Magic Islands await discovery.
* Journey through the Mahjong Magic Islands solving fun brain teasers.
* Meet mysterious and mythical creatures, and help them on their way!
* Hunt down magic ingredients and make magic spells.
* Search and connect tiles.
* Mahjong Solitaire

title: Rotate Cups
description:
This is a rotation physics puzzle game where you control the angle of cups to try to get the balls to roll into specific cups.
Rotate cups clockwise or counterclockwise as needed to turn the clear cups into ramps guiding the ball down the level.
Place at least one ball in each of the blue cups.
In this game you have to get all the balls into the blue cups lower down the screen.
Larger blue cups can hold more than one ball in them.
If there are multiple smaller blue cups you must get a ball into each of them.
Levels are not timed & you can both rotate as many times as you like & pause as many times as you like.

You can skip intermediary cups. On most levels you typically want to use all the cups on the way down, but if you are struggling to do so you can bump a ball off the outside of a cup or skip a cup entirely & it won’t harm you in the least provided your balls eventually get into the blue cups.
Some levels have a long reach you have to make the ball roll. On those levels sometimes a somewhat rapid cup spin toward the destination is enough, but in some cases you have to do that rapid spin as the starting point & then slightly spin back quickly right as the ball is leaving to give the ball a bit more lift.

title: Watermelon: Falling Animals
description:
Merge cute animals and create new, bigger, and rarer ones! 🐾
The more animals you combine, the higher your score and the faster you climb the leaderboard.

Compete with players from all over the world for the top spot in the rankings. Plan your strategy, use powerful boosts and combos to earn even more points and outperform your rivals.

Unlock new animals, set records, and prove that you are the true master of evolution!

Download the game now and start an exciting adventure in the world of animals!
Become the best and claim the title of the ultimate Animal Master! 🏆

title: Syntagma
description:
A puzzle adventure with platformer elements.

A suddenly arrived package contains a mysterious artifact, similar to a compass, and an ancient map pointing the way to five mysterious locations with abandoned temples.

To activate the compass and reveal the secrets of the temples, the hero must find unique crystals, symbolizing the five elements, scattered around the world.

To obtain a crystal, you can solve the puzzle only by jumping on active platforms. The correct sequence of stepping on the platforms and collecting all the keys on them opens the vault and grants access to the crystal. There are restrictions on moving across the platforms.

Moving backward and diagonally is prohibited.

Movement is only allowed forward, left, and right.

The start of movement activates defense mechanisms and obstacles that cause damage.

There are 2 difficulty levels, which can be changed in the main menu settings. After completing Level 0, the game will automatically suggest trying Level 1.

title: CLUTTER MASTER
description:
Clutter Master is a casual cozy game where you organize a messy room by placing each item where it belongs.
A secret awaits at the end of the game...

title: Bounce TD
description:
Welcome to Bounce TD — a unique fusion of classic Tower Defense strategy and addictive physics-based puzzles!

Are you ready to test your precision and tactical thinking? In this game, your mission is to protect your base from endless waves of enemies. But there’s a twist: your towers only activate when hit by a special energy ball. Calculate the trajectory, use the ricochet, and create deadly chain reactions!

title: Food Sort 3D
description:
In this game, you manage your own food court, sorting various food items into their respective categories. You'll encounter different eateries, from fast-food joints to upscale restaurants, each requiring you to sort items like burgers,
sushi, hotdog, fries, pizza and desserts. The game features colorful graphics and quick, satisfying levels that keep you engaged as you expand your food

title: Tangram Puzzle 2
description: Tangram Puzzle 2 is a classic tangram-style logic puzzle game in which players use a fixed set of colorful geometric pieces (tans) to exactly recreate a given target shape. The core idea revolves around spatial reasoning, rotation, and precise placement of pieces without overlaps or gaps. Its unique appeal lies in the vibrant, multi-colored pieces and targets (unlike traditional monochrome silhouettes), a progressive leveling system with star ratings based on efficiency (fewer moves earn more stars), and UI elements like move counters or hints that add strategic depth.

title: Bus Color Jam
description:
Bus Color Jam – Fun Puzzle Adventure with Colorful Challenges!

Get ready for Bus Jam, the ultimate bus game that’s all about matching passengers to their buses in this relaxing yet brain-teasing bus mania adventure. It's up to you to solve fun, colorful puzzles and clear the way to send each passenger on their dream vacation!

In this exciting puzzle game, you'll encounter progressively challenging levels as you advance. Your goal? Strategically match passengers with their correctly colored buses!

title: Stack the Blocks
description: Dive into the captivating world of Stack the Blocks, a strategic online puzzle game on a 10x10 grid. Challenge your logic by placing blocks to clear lines and earn points. Accessible yet complex, it guarantees addictive entertainment on both mobile and desktop platforms.

title: Hard Puzzle
description: A fascinating puzzle for everyone. A huge number of different levels will not let you get bored. Come every day and train your brain.

title: Dig & Flow - Save Water
description:
Dig through the sand and guide flowing elements through level labyrinths to collect all the stars. Use element physics, plan the route carefully, and control the streams to activate mechanisms and open new paths. Simple controls make the game easy to understand from the first seconds, but each level requires more logic and precision.

Different elements appear throughout the levels — water, lava, and hot steam. Each behaves differently and opens new ways to solve puzzles.

title: Wood Hexa Factory!
description:
Step into Wood Hexa Factory!, a satisfying puzzle game where you fill boxes by tapping colorful hexa pieces. Send the pieces down the conveyor belt and watch them fill the boxes to complete the levels. Simple but challenging, each level will test your strategy and puzzle-solving skills. If you're into puzzle games like hexa sort, card sort, wood puzzles, and a factory theme, this game is perfect for you.
"[Core Gameplay & Story]

Q: What is the game about? What do you need to do?
A: In the game, you need to sort wooden hexes into trays at a factory.

Q: Is there a storyline in the game?
A: There is no strict storyline, but the goal is clear: you must sort the hexes into trays while managing your workspace.

Q: What is the unique selling point of the game? How can it appeal to players?
A: Appealing graphics, good sound design, and the satisfying feeling of completing a task.

Q: What are the engaging content elements (weapons, vehicles, locations, skills, references to popular franchises, etc.)?
A: Appealing graphics and increasingly complex mechanics.

[Mechanics & Progression]

Q: How exactly does progression work? What should players do to level up faster?
A: Complete levels and expand your arsenal of upgrades.

[Economy & Customization]
