Q: What are the currencies in the game and what can they be spent on (e.g., standard - gold, premium - crystals, etc.)?
A: Money is spent on unlocking new slots and upgrades.

[Retention & Engagement]

Q: Is it recommended to play with sound for better immersion, or will playing without sound make the game difficult?
A: The music complements the game well, but it is not essential for completing the levels."

title: Tri Peaks Emerland Solitaire
description:
Tri Peaks Emerland Solitaire

Welcome to Tri Peaks Emerland Solitaire, the land of card magic! An incredible journey awaits you, in a beautiful world filled with dwarfs, elves, mermaids and many other amazing creatures.

Be the hero the world needs!

Welcome to Tri Peaks Emerland Solitaire, the land of card magic! An incredible journey awaits you, in a beautiful world filled with dwarfs, elves, mermaids and many other amazing creatures.
Colorful locations, numerous card combos, helpful companions, and many hours of journeying—all of this awaits you in Emerland Solitaire: Endless Journey.

Wisk away to a land filled with wonder and danger. As a new adventurer, you must learn about all the dangers that face you while traversing enchanted forests, majestic bluffs, and more!

Play Tri Peaks Emerland Solitaire for:
MYSTICAL CARD PUZZLES!
FANTASTIC WILD CARDS!
EARN STARS FOR SKILL!

title: Pinata Color Smash
description:
Smash Color Pinatas by Selecting the matching color bat. You can Select Bats on top and then the bottom bats are revealed.
You can Place Extra Bats on 5 Tile Slots and use them when needed.
Pinatas Color Smash is a colorful and engaging puzzle game where players aim to break Pinatas by selecting matching colored bats. The game offers a fun and casual experience suitable for all ages.

title: Liquid Sort Puzzle
description: Liquid Sort Puzzle is a highly relaxing yet mentally stimulating color-sorting puzzle game set in a vibrant jungle environment. The main idea is to sort mixed colored liquids across various test tubes until each tube contains only one uniform color. What makes this game unique is its soothing ASMR-like pouring animations combined with a rewarding "Lucky Spin" system, allowing players to earn 'Undo' and 'Restart' power-ups to conquer increasingly complex levels. It's the perfect blend of casual brain-training and satisfying visual feedback!

title: Circuit Master 2
description: Arrange the wires, fans, and machines in the right places, then turn on the power button to see the electricity flow. Only the correctly connected components will make the green light shine.

title: Slinger
description: Guide a red square through compact grid levels in this modern minimalist puzzle game. Clear paths, collect every yellow key, unlock the yellow door, and slip through to win. Each level challenges your thinking with simple mechanics, subtle complexity, and clean, focused design.

title: Arrows Disappear
description: You are faced with a growing stack of 3D blocks, each showing different arrow directions. The core idea is quick decision-making — tap the blocks with upward arrows to make them disappear before the tower collapses. What makes it unique? Clean 3D visuals with satisfying physics, increasing speed and complexity, one-tap simple controls, and the tense “just one more level” feeling as the stack gets taller and faster!

title: Draw The Snake
description:
Draw The Snake is a fun and colorful puzzle game where players guide snakes through grid-based levels by choosing the correct path. Your goal is to move the snake smartly, collect apples, clear obstacles, and complete each puzzle without getting stuck.

Each level becomes more challenging with tricky paths, ice blocks, and clever puzzle layouts. The game is easy to understand but needs good planning and strategy to master. With simple controls, bright visuals, and relaxing puzzle gameplay, Draw The Snake is perfect for players who enjoy brain-training games.

title: Box Tap Sort
description: A head-to-head 3D color-sort puzzle. Dismantle candy-colored cube stacks by tapping cubes that match your active color orders. Wrong taps fill a limited holding bin — overflow resets the puzzle. Clear more structures than your rival before time runs out.

title: Flag Puzzle Jam: Collect Flags
description: Explore the intriguing realm of Flag Puzzle Jam, where puzzle-solving and flag collection unite. This engaging and free online game offers both relaxation and an opportunity to discover national symbols. Enjoy a colorful and seamless experience on any device as you embark on this worldwide quest.

title: Monster Slayer: Merge & Survive
description: Experience the excitement of Monster Slayer: Merge & Survive, a dynamic game where you merge items to craft powerful tools and potions. Test your strategy as you navigate dungeons. Play for free online on both mobile and desktop. Embrace your heroic side!

title: Word Chef
description: Word Chef is a classic word search puzzle game. This free word game makes learning new words fun. It comes with 6 difficulties ranging from Beginner to Expert and there are more than 500 levels in total. Simply swipe letters from the word scramble to create a word. Connect the letters, find the words, and sharpen your word skills as you go.

title: Arcuz Treasure Hunters
description: "Arcuz Treasure Hunters" is a Fantasy JRPG game with treasure hunting theme, where players explore underground caves, decipher maze-like machenics, challenge powerful enemies, collect rare treasures, and assemble a strong team with diverse abilities through hiring various companions.

title: City Pilot Plane Parking Jam
description:
✈️ City Pilot Plane Parking Jam – Airport Traffic Puzzle Challenge! 🧩🚦

Welcome to City Pilot Plane Parking Jam, the ultimate airplane parking puzzle game where you manage the chaos of the world’s busiest airport! With planes constantly landing, taxiing, and taking off, the airport ground becomes a maze of aircraft, obstacles, and tight parking spots. Your mission? Clear the parking jam, guide the planes safely, and restore order to the runway!

This challenging airplane parking jam simulator mixes strategic thinking, IQ-boosting puzzles, and airport management gameplay, making it perfect for fans of parking games, traffic jam puzzles, and aircraft simulators.

🛫 Clear the Airport Parking Chaos!

The airport is full of blocked paths, stuck airplanes, cargo jets, and obstacles. To succeed, you must:

Untangle the airplane traffic jam

Move each aircraft safely without causing collisions

Navigate tight spots like a true puzzle parking master

Use your brain like in IQ games & parking lot logic puzzles

Just like car parking jam games—but BIGGER, trickier, and way more intense with REAL planes!

🌟 Key Features

🛩️ Unique airplane parking jam gameplay inspired by parking lot puzzles

🚦 Smooth drag-and-move controls for all aircraft types

✨ Challenging levels with increasing complexity

🧠 Brain-testing puzzle mechanics perfect for IQ & logic puzzle lovers

🌍 Realistic airport environment with runways, taxiways & hangars

📦 Cargo planes, jets & aircraft variety to clear from each jam

🔧 Smart parking strategies to avoid accidents & traffic blockages

🎵 Relaxing sounds & clean visuals to keep you engaged

🚁 Offline play support – enjoy anytime, anywhere



The challenge grows as more planes, bigger jets, and tighter parking areas appear!

🛩️ Become the Airport Puzzle Master!

From tangled runways to blocked taxiways, every level tests your concentration, spatial awareness, and strategic planning, just like real airport management. Make smart moves, avoid disasters, and master the art of airplane parking.

title: Deconstruct Cube: Create Hotel
description: A game inspired by the USSR! Start upgrading your hotel with the 2048 cube puzzle! Build the hotel of your dreams!

title: Sorting Nuts and Bolts by Color: Home Repair
description:
Ready for some fun sorting? 🧩 The free puzzle game "Nut Sorter" invites you to relax and exercise your mind! Your task is to sort colorful nuts into bolts, creating perfect color chains. Over 15,000 levels with no time limit await you!

🎨 Soothing gameplay mechanics with tactile feedback and pleasant sounds.
⚡ Use bonuses: extra bolts, undo, and restart.
❓ Uncover the secret colors of the nuts under the question marks.
🏡 Build your dream home, earning rewards for completing levels.
😌 Comfortable Effects
Soothing ASMR-inspired sounds combined with haptic feedback provide an exceptional nut sorting experience!

Simply tap the bolts to move the nuts. Sort colors, plan your moves, and enjoy endless puzzles! Perfect for relaxing and developing your attention span. Download and immerse yourself in the world of color logic! 😍

🔩 FREE • 15,000 levels • No timers • For all ages

title: Emoji Math Quiz
description: Embark on a brain-teasing adventure with Emoji Math, the game that blends math puzzles with emoji fun! Challenge yourself through six equations where each emoji represents a numerical value. Sharpen your skills as you decipher the emoji codes to solve each equation correctly. Dive into Emoji Math and unravel the mystery behind every emoji's value to conquer this exciting mathematical journey!

title: Cube Crushers
description:
Welcome to Cube Crushers, a fun and satisfying sorting puzzle game filled with colorful cake slices, cute cube characters, and smart puzzle challenges.

Tap the cake slices on the grid, send them to the conveyor, and unlock hidden cube crushers behind them. Each crusher has its own color and eats only the matching cake slices. Choose your moves carefully because every tap can change the puzzle result.

Cube Crushers is easy to play but becomes more challenging as you progress. With cute characters, smooth effects, colorful visuals, and handcrafted levels, this game gives you a relaxing yet strategic puzzle experience.

title: Connect Words 2026
description:
🧠 “Connect Words 2026” is not just a word game — it is a whole collection of engaging word mini-games in one app!
Connect letters, find hidden words, complete unique challenges, and unlock new trials across 1,500+ levels.

🌟 Why is this game worth trying?
• Different types of mini-games — more variety, less repetition
• 1500+ levels — long and engaging gameplay
• Brain training — improve your memory, attention, and vocabulary
• Smooth difficulty progression — comfortable for beginners and interesting for experienced players
• Relaxing gameplay — play at your own pace at home, on the go, or on vacation

💡 The unique advantage of “Connect Words 2026” is the combination of a classic word game and various mini-games, making every session interesting and never boring.

If you enjoy crosswords, word searches, puzzles, and brain games, this game will be a great everyday choice! 🎉

title: Cyberpunk Block Puzzle
description:
Cyberpunk Block Puzzle is a stylish logic game set on a neon circuit board. Slide glowing blocks across the grid to
  deliver them to matching colored connectors. Each block moves only along its axis — you'll need to think several moves
   ahead.

  70+ levels with increasing difficulty: walls, ice blocks, and locks on grids from 5×5 to 8×9. Earn chips, climb the
  hacker ranks from Noob to Hack Guru, and take on a fresh daily challenge every day.

  A smart hint system keeps you moving, while neon glow effects and juicy animations reward every move. Easy to start —
  hard to put down.

title: Kitten's Way Home: Word Associations
description:
Looking for a game for the evening? A puzzle that brings people together! Play against a friend on one screen or against artificial intelligence. The rules are simple, the adrenaline is high.
A fun and simple word duel: guess words associated with the theme. Perfect brain training, an excellent educational game, and fun time well spent.
Test yourself and your erudition. Can you guess all the associations?

title: Fruite Swipe
description:
Get ready for a juicy adventure with Fruit Swipe Match, Swipe and match colorful fruits to solve exciting puzzles and unlock fantastic rewards. With hundreds of challenging levels, stunning graphics, and smooth gameplay, this match-3 game will keep you entertained for hours.

Compete with friends, discover hidden treasures, and master fun power-ups. Download Fruit Swipe Match now and experience the ultimate fruit-matching fun. It's time to swipe, match, and win big!

title: Mahjong 3D Match
description: Welcome to the 3D Mahjong adventure! Challenge your mind with speed and precision. Plan your moves, view the board from all angles and remove pieces intelligently. Beat increasingly difficult levels, play offline and relax with immersive music.

title: Alchemy Elixir of Life
description:
Alchemy: Elixir of Life is an exciting puzzle game in which you can feel like a real creator. Create and find all the elements to save your beloved! Find the elixir of life right now!
Start with four simple elements — fire, water, earth and air — and create everything that exists in the world. Connect the elements, discover new combinations and watch as order is born out of chaos.

Each discovery brings joy, and each new combination brings you closer to solving all the mysteries of the universe.
Use logic, imagination and intuition, because there is no single path in alchemy, only your own.

title: Untangle Threads
description:
"Untangle Threads" — a beautiful puzzle game where you drag nodes so that no thread crosses another.

6 unique worlds, each with its own mechanic:
- Neon — classic puzzles to warm up
- Nature — new threads appear as you solve
- Space — some nodes are locked in place
- Ocean — nodes drift with the current
- Crystals — limited number of moves
- Steampunk — linked nodes move as mirror images

title: Match Challenge
description: A simple but engaging matching challenge! Look at the variety of items at the bottom of the screen, and tap four that belong to the same category whether it's fruits, tools, animals, or household objects. Think fast, but choose wisely!

title: Playful Cup
description:
The glass is sad because it's empty. Your job is to make the glass filled up with liquid and smile again!

Try to find the best way to complete each level. You can come up with your own solution so be creative and don't be afraid to think out of the box!

There are 3 game modes to play!

title: Push The Box
description:
Welcome to Push The Box, a fun and engaging game where you solve puzzles by just pushing buttons and sliding pieces. Complete different stage missions and try out harder levels as you improve!

Game Features:
- Use handy features like reset and undo to make your gameplay smooth.
- Watch replays of your successful stages to see how you solved them.
- Enjoy clean and stylish graphics that make the game a delight to play.
- Earn achievements and compare your scores with others on the leaderboard.
- Perfectly designed for smart pads and tablets for gaming on the go.

So, if you’re looking for a game that’s easy to understand but also challenges your brain, Push Maze Puzzle is perfect for you! Slide into the puzzle fun and start solving today!

title: Match Master
description:
Get ready for a new, challenging and original matching pairs brain game.
You need to match 3D objects on the ground and pop them all! When you clear a level, you will find new objects to pair. Sort and find all pairs, clear the board and win!

Start searching for hidden object and matching tile pairs - Match 3D is a perfect way to zen relaxing and at the same time testing your memory and mind skills.

title: Paint Pop 3D
description:
Paint Pop 3D is an one-tap hyper casual shooting game that will keep you hooked for hours!

Tap to paint. Hold for more fun!
Stay away from obstacles and paint all slices on the ring.

Features:
- More than 1000+ levels to experience game play.
- A lot challenging missions.
- Various characters & themes.
- Beautiful graphic.

title: Hook Pin Jam
description:
Master the art of hooking in this addictive puzzle game! Solve intricate puzzles by untie the hooks to accumulate wealth
In Hook Jam, players are tasked with solving intricate puzzles by untying hooks to accumulate wealth. The game offers a variety of challenges that test your strategic thinking and problem-solving skills. As you progress, the puzzles become more complex, keeping you engaged and motivated.

title: Sort It Out: Category Sort
description:
A fast-paced, head-to-head card sorting game. Cards are stacked on a wooden tabletop grid, each showing an emoji or icon (animals, food, tech, sports, and more). You race a rival to sort cards into the right category slots before the clock runs out.
Each match is a 90-second duel. You and your opponent share the same kind of puzzle: stacks of mixed cards and gold goal slots labeled with categories like Animals, Food, or Tech. Whoever completes the most full categories when time expires wins.

title: Monster Merge: Legends Alive
description: Monster Merge: Legends Alive is a fun puzzle game where you combine monsters to score points and advance. Playable online for free, it features engaging gameplay with mythical creatures. Available on both desktops and Android, it offers an enjoyable experience for all ages who love a good challenge.

title: Heart Box
description:
Professor Rat loves physics puzzles and games with robots! Therefore, he created Robby, but gave him a weak battery, which is why the little robot has to constantly recharge and participate in crazy experiments. Interact with various physical objects to guide robot Robby through all of Professor Rat's puzzle rooms and free him from the charger! Don't want to play the game? Then create your own amazing puzzles in the Level Editor!

Features of the game:

- Over 180 levels for your brain
- Online database "Community Levels" with over 10000 levels by players
- Level Editor and Collection of QR Levels
- Various skins for the robot
- 4 fun game modes
- Realistic physics
- Lots of cartoons
- Leaderboards & Achievements

title: Neon Goal
description:
Step into the Neon Arena and test your aim in this fun physics puzzle game!
Your mission is simple: throw the ball and reach the net but the challenge is real because you have limited hits and obstacles are everywhere. 
Each level is a new puzzle where you must think, aim, and throw perfectly to win.

If you love short, satisfying puzzle levels with neon style, Neon Goal is a perfect quick-play game for you.

title: Build My Brainrot
description: Build My Brainrot is a casual puzzle–simulation game where players collect and place colored blocks on a grid to complete quirky “brainrot” characters. Blending light resource management with creative pattern-building, the game’s core idea revolves around filling shapes efficiently while upgrading abilities like speed and inventory. Its charm comes from its simple controls, humorous character designs, and the satisfying progression of turning scattered resources into complete, animated figures.

title: Tile Harvest 3D
description: Tile Harvest 3D is a 3D tile-matching puzzle game with a satisfying merge twist. Clear a towering stack of colorful 3D tiles by collecting matching sets and chaining them into powerful merges. With unlimited levels, escalating challenge, and a set of special boosters to save you in a pinch, every puzzle is a fresh brain-teaser.

title: Tile Match Camp
description:
Tile Match Camp is a relaxing and addictive triple-match puzzle game set in a beautiful camping world. Explore nature, match colorful items, and clear challenging levels as you journey through forests, campsites, and outdoor adventures.

Match three identical tiles to remove them from the board and uncover new challenges. Plan your moves carefully, keep your tray from filling up, and complete each level to advance further into the adventure.

With charming visuals, smooth gameplay, and hundreds of satisfying puzzles, Camp Match Adventure is perfect for players who enjoy casual brain-training games and relaxing puzzle experiences.

Can you master every level and become the ultimate camping puzzle explorer?

title: Aqua Sort: Water Color Puzzle
description: Dive into the relaxing world of Aqua Sort: Water Color Puzzle! Your goal is simple: sort the colored liquids into the flasks until each flask contains only one color. With over 1000 levels and unique modes like Color Fusion, Mystery, and Time Trial, this puzzle game will test your logic and patience. Unlock new themes and achievements as you play!

title: Cookie Match
description:
Cookie Match is a sliding puzzle game where you must match each cookie to its corresponding cutter.

If you move the cookies off the edge of the board or into knives, they’ll be destroyed. Use the tubs of butter as barriers to keep the cookies in one piece.

title: Sudoku - Number Games
description:
Увлекательная логическая игра-головоломка с числами! Тренируйте внимание, развивайте память и логику, да и просто получайте удовольствие!

По мере повышения уровня игра усложняется, но всегда можно вернутся к прошлым уровням и играть на более легком уровне сложности.

title: Okay
description:
Okay? is a minimalist puzzle game that turns simple shapes into clever challenges. Every level is made of blocks, lines, and objects placed on a clean, abstract screen. Your goal is simple: clear all the objects with just one perfect move.

Draw a line with your finger, release it, and watch it bounce around the screen. If your move is right, the line will hit and remove every object until the screen is empty. Sounds easy? As levels go up, the puzzles get smarter, requiring perfect angles, timing, and logic.

title: Hex Block Puzzle Master
description:
Engage your mind 🧠 and enjoy satisfying puzzle moments with Hex Block Puzzle Master 🟣⬡ – a relaxing yet challenging hex puzzle experience! Place colorful hex blocks 🎨 into the grid, solve clever layouts, and watch the board come alive ✨ as you complete each puzzle.

Designed for both casual fun 🎮 and deep thinking, Hex Block Puzzle Master offers endless entertainment without stress or pressure 😌.

Why You’ll Love Hex Block Puzzle Master ❤️

• Sharpen Your Mind 🧠
Challenge your logic and spatial thinking with carefully designed hex puzzles that get smarter as you progress 🔥.

• Relax & Enjoy 🌿
No timers, no rush ⏳❌. Play at your own pace and enjoy a calm, stress-free puzzle experience 😴✨.

• Beautiful & Colorful 🎨
Bright hex blocks, smooth animations, and clean visuals make every puzzle satisfying to complete 💎.

How to Play 🕹️

• Drag hexagonal blocks ⬡ and place them into the grid.
• Blocks cannot be rotated 🔄❌, so plan your moves wisely 🤔.
• Fill the available spaces perfectly to complete the puzzle ✅.
• Progress through increasingly challenging layouts and obstacles 🚀.

Features You’ll Enjoy ⭐

• Simple Yet Addictive Gameplay 🎯
Easy to start, hard to master – perfect for all ages 👶➡️🧓.

• Tons of Unique Puzzles 🧩
Enjoy hundreds (and more) of handcrafted hex challenges 🔢🔥.

• Rewards & Bonuses 🪙🎁
Earn coins and rewards to keep the fun going.

• Auto Save 💾
Your progress is always saved automatically.

• Play Anytime, Anywhere 📱🌍
Great for short breaks or long, relaxing play sessions 😌.

Train your mind 🧠, relax your thoughts 🌿, and become a true puzzle master 👑 with Hex Block Puzzle Master ✨🎮

title: Bouncy Arrow
description:
Bouncy Arrow is a colorful and satisfying puzzle game where every arrow shot creates a fun bouncing action. Aim carefully, choose the right direction, and pop the colorful orbs with smart timing.

The game is simple to understand but challenging to master. Each level needs focus, planning, and the correct move order. Do not throw arrows randomly  watch the color pattern, understand the path, and shoot the arrow at the perfect time.

With bright visuals, smooth gameplay, and satisfying popping effects, Bouncy Arrow is perfect for players who love relaxing puzzle games, arrow games, color matching games, and smart tap puzzle challenges.

Play carefully, think before every shot, and enjoy the smooth bounce and pop puzzle experience.

title: Sticker Jam: Peel Off & Match
description: Dive into the lively experience of Sticker Jam, a free online puzzle game that merges sticker collecting with engaging challenges. Whether on your phone or computer, it's an enjoyable way to relax and stimulate your mind after a busy day.

title: Magic Block Sort
description:
Magic Block Sort is a fun, addictive, and brain-teasing puzzle game that will keep you entertained for hours! If you love classic sorting games but want a fresh, magical twist with 3D blocks, this is the perfect game for you.

Your mission is simple but challenging: sort all the magic blocks with matching colors and symbols into their own tubes. Strategy and forward thinking are your best tools. As you progress, the levels become more complex with more blocks, hidden mystery symbols, and extra tubes to test your IQ! Can you master the ultimate sorting puzzle?

title: Brain Coloring Puzzle
description:
Discover Italian Brainrot Meme Coloring Puzzle Game
Step into the viral world of Italian Brainrot Meme Characters, where over thirty absurd creatures await your palette. No numbers, no hints—only your eye for color and a playful spirit.

Meet the Stars

Bombardiro Crocodilo: Our most fiendish color‑match boss.

Tung Tung Tung Tung Sahur: A viral sensation inspired by Italian Brainrot.

Shimpanzinni Bananinni, Boneca Ambalabu, Tralalero Tralala and many more bring humor and challenge.

Why You’ll Love It

Brain‑Boosting Fun: Sharpens visual memory and logic.

Creative Freedom: No right answer—trust your instincts.

Offline Play: Dive in anytime, anywhere.

Designed for Ages 12+: Simple enough for kids, intriguing for teens and adults.

Ready to color outside the lines? Tap Install and unleash your inner artist on the most delightfully absurd paint‑puzzle around!

title: Paint Sponges Puzzle
description: Tap into your creativity with Paint Sponges Puzzle, a captivating online game that requires strategic skills and maze-solving ability. Navigate your colorful sponge across the grid, leaving a vibrant trail. Challenges increase as you advance, providing a fun blend of logic and artistry on both mobile and computer platforms.

title: Connect Puzzle Image
description:
Were you one of those children who could spend hours with their puzzles, whiling away a rainy afternoon or cold winter’s day putting together a 500-piece jigsaw of the Eifel Tower or London Bridge? Well, now you can revisit your childhood on your smartphone or tablet from anywhere in the world.

Melt away from reality with this captivating puzzle game that challenges you to use your thinking skills to connect virtual pieces in real time and create unique images of increasing complexity. Arrange a variety of items to produce a pretty picture right on your screen, while developing your abilities as you progress through the levels. You’ll never be bored again!

title: Blasting Marbles
description: Blasting Marbles is a thrilling 2D puzzle adventure game where your objective is to strategically place the required number of marbles into the hole. Explore the game world, collecting crates to boost your marble count and discover marbles with unique abilities. Switch between marbles to split their efforts and coordinate teamwork for successful challenges. Immerse yourself in a captivating gameplay experience that combines puzzle, physics, and skill.

title: Connect Line
description:
Connect Lines is a puzzle game in which the goal is to rotate line-segments so that together they form a continuous connected path or network i.e. all the lines must join up into one single connected structure.
It is simple in appearance but grows challenging, because you must figure out the correct orientation of each piece so that the network is complete without any breaks.
As the puzzle advances, the arrangement / layout becomes more complex. The number of line-pieces increases, the shapes become more varied, and finding the correct connection scheme becomes harder. You may need to think ahead about how rotating one piece will affect connections with several adjacent pieces. (This is standard for these kinds of puzzles.)

title: Hexa Block Puzzle
description:
Try our highly addictive unique hexagonal pieces puzzle game!
Use your puzzle skill and put blocks into board.
Hexa BlockPuzzle will improve your logical skills and mind power.
Difficulty level will be increase as much as you play.

title: Jixora – Jigsaw Solitaire Puzzle
description: Jixora is a relaxing jigsaw solitaire puzzle game where you piece together beautiful artwork. Journey through 100 unique levels with increasing difficulty, or unlock Free Play mode to replay your favorites with custom grid sizes. Race against the clock to earn stars, use strategic power-ups like Hints and Time Freezes, and immerse yourself in a cinematic atmosphere with soothing music.

title: Alpha Balls
description: Alpha Balls is a stimulating word puzzle game that sharpens your mind and vocabulary. Enjoy it online for free on any device. Solve puzzles to earn coins for hints, making it an entertaining and educational challenge for all.

title: Stackitaire
description:
Stackitaire is an addictive solitaire card-sorting puzzle. Shuffle through stacks of mixed cards and sort them into complete suits — one suit per stack. Every level deals a new layout that gets trickier as locked cards, hidden decks, and tighter stacks are introduced. With hundreds of levels, daily bonuses, and handy boosters to rescue a tough hand, Stackitaire is the perfect blend of classic solitaire and satisfying puzzle play.

Tips:
Keep at least one stack empty as a holding spot — it gives you room to reorganize.
Think a few moves ahead before placing a card; getting blocked is how levels get tough.
Use Undo before spending a Hint.

title: Blocks Adventure Jungle Saga
description: In jungle lands where wild vines grow, drag and drop blocks in a vibrant flow. Match them right and hear them click: stack up points and do it quick!

title: Nullify - Merge Math
description:
Nullify is a minimal abstract relaxing puzzle with the goal of clearing everything from the screen by merging numbers and math symbols.
Improve your logic and math skills by completing unique handcrafted levels and infinite generated levels.

Features:
-56 Levels to complete
-4 Infinite games modes
-Simple and easy controls by dragging elements
-13 math symbols

title: Mindblow
description:
Welcome to Mindblow: Guess the Word! Experience a word-guessing game like no other, where every image cleverly hides a word. Unlike other games, this game isn’t just a mix of stock images, but we've carefully created each level’s image to challenge your brain! Discover the word through a concept creatively depicted in each picture.

A New Kind of Puzzle: Forget what you know about word quiz games. In Mindblow: Guess the Word, each image has a special word for you to guess. It’s not just about looking at the picture, but understanding the clever idea behind it.

title: Zip Zap
description: Dive into Zip Zap, a beautifully minimalist physics puzzle where simplicity meets ingenuity. In this one-touch adventure, you guide quirky mechanical beings across intricate levels, orchestrating movement with just a tap and a release.

title: SORTY BOLTY
description: SORTY BOLTY revolves around the theme of organization and color coordination. Players are tasked with sorting vibrant nuts onto corresponding bolts, creating a visually satisfying and mentally stimulating experience. The game's appeal lies in its straightforward mechanics that gradually increase in complexity, challenging players to think several moves ahead.

title: Village of Colors
description: Dive into the lively realm of Village of Colors, where your imagination is key. In this free online game, defend the village by sketching protective barriers. With unique villagers and challenging foes, you can pause time and boost your skills to keep your vibrant home safe.

title: BuildemUp
description: BuildemUp is an entertaining and cool game where you should put various color and shape blocks on a cargo machine in order to deliver them and finish building beautiful houses. You will enjoy the challenge of keeping all these weird blocks on the truck. As you progress in game you will earn coins witch you can buy and unlock other cool looking trucks and activate power up to help you advance more easily in levels. BuildemUp is an ideal game for all ages, providing easy to difficult mind challenges and enhancing puzzle solving skills.

title: Bloop!
description:
Bloop is a brainy isometric maze puzzler. Each level is a small grid, roll Bloop around, collect every diamond to open the exit, then reach it before your energy runs out. Every step costs energy, so the clever route always wins.

Across four themed worlds: Splash Garden, Frankenstein Lab, Wonderland and Lost Pyramid and 130+ levels, paths that look obvious rarely are.

title: SNAKES
description: SNAKES is a fun and relaxing puzzle game where you guide colorful snakes to fill the entire board. With over many handcrafted levels, the game challenges your mind with clever layouts that get trickier as you progress. The minimalist art style and amusing background music make it enjoyable for all ages. Play at your own pace or compete with friends to see who can solve the puzzles faster. If you love brain teasers, logic puzzles, or casual games, SNAKES is the perfect choice!

title: Solve the maze
description:
The game will appeal to fans of puzzles. There are 100 unique levels in the game. The difficulty of the levels gradually increases. If the level is too difficult for you, you can skip it by watching a video advertisement. For each level you complete, you are given crystals that can be spent on unlocking new items. Collect the entire collection!
You will definitely like:
- Smooth ball movement
- Lots of beautiful and vibrant paint colors
- Simple one touch control
- Great way to kill time

title: Ninja dash: Cozy tactic puzzle
description: Dive into the exciting realm of Ninja Dash: Cozy Tactic Puzzle, a free online game where stealth and strategy unite. As a ninja tactician, eliminate foes with careful planning, using your surroundings to perfect each move, whether on your phone or computer.

title: Mahjong Tower: Puzzles
description:
Mahjong Tower: Puzzles are a mix of "puzzle" and "three-in-a-row" genres in a mahjong setting.
An exciting puzzle game for MAHJONG and THREE-IN-A-ROW fans! More than 60 levels of varying difficulty. SOLVE THEM ALL!

Combine mahjong tiles to remove them from the board or create special tiles that will help you clear the board even more effectively.

Solve fascinating puzzles in the "Puzzles" game mode.
Clear the board from mahjong tiles in the "Board Clearing" game mode.
Score as many points as you can in the endless "Arcade" game mode.

title: Cute Shapes
description: "Cute Shapes" is an adorable casual observation puzzle for the whole family. Spot the differences among cute shapes with eyes, solve fun little challenges, and train your powers of observation!

title: Match Story : Animals
description: Match Story Animals is a fun and addictive 3D puzzle game where players must match cute animal objects to clear the board. With smooth gameplay, colorful graphics, and hundreds of levels, it offers hours of entertainment for puzzle lovers. Use power-ups, boosters, and smart strategies to progress through challenging stages. Perfect for casual gamers of all ages!

title: Crazy Emoji Blast
description: Match colorful emojis, chain explosive combos, and blast your way through 10 increasingly challenging levels! Swap adjacent emojis to create matches of 3 or more — trigger row blasts, column blasts, cross explosions, and total nukes. Watch out for bombs hidden on the board — match near them to unleash devastating chain reactions

title: Balls: Pixel Art
description:
Balls: Pixel Art is a game about knocking out pictures with balloons. More precisely, you
have to disassemble the drawn picture into pixels by breaking it up with balloons.
This is a very interesting, exciting process. In which you need to show ingenuity,
and accurate calculation. The game has to offer:
- Exciting gameplay.
- Multiple images for you to smash
- Nice graphics
- Lots of levels to complete
Ready to be the Anti-Artist? Cracking the works of art? Then onward to new
victories!Balls: Pixel Art

title: Commit
description:
Explore an isometric world full of puzzles where every move is permanent. Take control of a curious cat that must traverse all the tiles in each level to collect food—but beware: every tile you step on disappears forever.
No turning back.
Only pure strategy.

title: Purrfect Match
description:
Welcome to a cozy casual match-3 game with cats, created for relaxation and pleasant emotions.

In this match-3 puzzle, you connect identical cats by drawing a continuous line across the board using your finger or mouse. You can create combinations of three or more tiles horizontally, vertically, or in an L shape. Diagonal connections are not allowed, so each move requires attention and planning.

The game has no rush — you play at a comfortable pace, enjoying the cute visual style and warm, relaxing atmosphere. Each level offers a new objective and gradually increases in difficulty while maintaining a balanced and enjoyable experience.

Bright 2D graphics, soft colors, and adorable cats make the game perfect for unwinding. The vertical layout is ideal for mobile devices and one-handed play. The game is suitable for all ages and will especially appeal to fans of cats and relaxing puzzle games.

title: Luna And The Magic Maze
description: Join Luna in her enchanting quest through a mystical autumn forest in "Luna And The Magic Maze." Solve mazes, collect magical artifacts, and uncover secrets. Each stage presents fresh challenges, proving that willpower can be as powerful as magic, whether you play on your phone or computer.

title: Luna And The Magic Maze
description: Join Luna in her enchanting quest through a mystical autumn forest in "Luna And The Magic Maze." Solve mazes, collect magical artifacts, and uncover secrets. Each stage presents fresh challenges, proving that willpower can be as powerful as magic, whether you play on your phone or computer.

title: Stellar Shot-Gravity Puzzle
description: Stellar Shot is a physics-based space puzzle where every shot bends to gravity. Drag to aim, release to launch, and use orbiting planets, heavy masses, repulsion fields, and wormholes to curve your path into the portal. Each level rewards precision with fewer shots and smarter trajectories. From gentle intro stages to challenging late-game puzzles, Stellar Shot is easy to pick up and satisfying to master. Plan ahead, read the gravity, and find the cleanest route through the cosmos.

title: Blocky Set - 3d brick constructions
description:
A 3D emulator of real-life brick-building games, where you are presented with a complete model and must reproduce it by placing the pieces in the correct location.

Enjoy!

title: Fill The Lines
description: Lines to Fill is a thinking game where you draw lines to complete the given puzzle shape. Simply drag one of the colorful blocks using your finger or the left mouse button, and make sure there are no blank spots left. Since the game has no time limits and no way to lose, you can enjoy this stress-free experience complete with hundreds of unique levels on your computer or mobile device. Can you block out some time and finish every level?

title: Happy Farm 1 Line Puzzle
description: Happy Farm 1 Line Puzzle is a charming and addictive one-line puzzle game where players draw a single continuous line to connect and activate all the water pipes on the farm. Set in a vibrant, colorful cartoon farm filled with blooming flowers, cute animals, and relaxing scenery, the core gameplay revolves around clever pipe-connecting logic that challenges your spatial thinking. With its relaxing atmosphere, satisfying one-stroke mechanics, and progressively tricky levels, it brings the joy of farming and puzzle-solving together in one delightful package.

title: Safari Match
description: Safari Match is an exciting, jungle-themed memory puzzle game where players test their focus and speed by finding matching animal cards. Navigate through beautifully illustrated exotic wildlife cards against a ticking clock. As you progress, the grid expands, offering greater challenges and higher rewards. Unlock special power-ups like 'Reveal All' or 'Row Reveal' to help you conquer the hardest levels. Featuring vibrant artwork, dynamic animations, global leaderboards, and an immersive safari atmosphere, it's a premium brain-teasing adventure suitable for all ages!

title: Match Story: Weapons
description:
🔫 Match Story: Weapons takes you into an action-packed puzzle adventure!
Match powerful weapons, expand your arsenal, and challenge your brain in this fun and addictive 3D puzzle game.

⏳ Solve tricky puzzles against the clock, keep your mind sharp, and become smarter with every level!

🧠 Each stage gets harder, testing your reflexes and thinking skills.

✨ Discover unique weapon models you’ve never seen before, build powerful combos, and master the art of matching!

🎯 Key Features:
🔥 Fun and addictive match-3 gameplay
🪖 Discover unique weapons never seen before
⏱️ Race against time – solve puzzles before time runs out
🎨 Colorful and eye-catching 3D graphics
🧩 Increasingly challenging puzzles and levels
🧠 Keep your brain active & boost your intelligence

Merge your weapons, unlock new levels, and write your own matching story.

title: Hungry Cats
description: Hungry Cats is a casual puzzle game where you guide several cats at the same time to find their food. By rotating the entire level, you must think carefully about how every cat moves together. This unique mechanic turns simple movement into a fun and playful puzzle challenge. 🐾

title: Unravel Eggs Puzzle
description: Celebrate Easter weekend in style this year with the sweet new puzzle game, Unravel Eggs Puzzle! Complete each level by untangling eggs such that each line connecting eggs is not intersected by any other line connecting eggs. Warm up with some light puzzles and work your way up to an egg-tangling like you've never seen! Happy Easter!

title: The Fill
description:
Sharpen your mind with a connect-the-block-style one-line brain training puzzle game.
A simple but addictive one-line puzzle game that’s completely free to play.

Your brain becomes more active the more you play.
During your commute, before you sleep… enjoy downtime with brain training.

The rules are extremely simple.
Just fill in all of the blocks using only one line.

Use hints for puzzles that are too hard to solve.
Hints are also free, of course.

title: Car Parking Order
description: Join an exciting adventure in mastering parking skills with Car Parking Order. This fun online game tests your ability to park vehicles in the right order amidst traffic and barriers. As levels progress, challenges become tougher. Play for free on any device and see if you can solve them all!

title: Brain Draw Line
description:
Put your mind to the test with Brain Draw Line: Link Dots, a simple yet captivating puzzle game that challenges creativity and logic. Draw one continuous line without lifting your finger or going backward to connect the dots and finish complicated designs.

The goal of this game is simple: create a single, continuous line without lifting your finger or overlapping any lines to link all the dots in a specific shape. With each level, the puzzles get more complex.

title: Merge Balls Shooter 2048 Connect Fruits
description: Dive into the exciting world of Merge Balls Shooter 2048 Connect Fruits, a free game that blends 2048 with billiards in a fruity setting. Enjoy merging fruit balls on your devices while savoring ASMR sounds through challenging levels, all while aiming for high scores. Experience nonstop fun!

title: Smash the Blocks! Puzzle Challenge
description:
Tap the arrows and remove the blocks! A logical puzzle game for adults! Can you beat all levels?

Smash the Blocks! Puzzle Challenge is a relaxing puzzle game where you need to remove blocks by tapping the arrows. Clear the field, solve puzzles, and complete levels at your own pace.

This is a casual logic game that combines puzzle gameplay, an anti-stress experience, and thinking challenges. Simple controls make it accessible for everyone, while gradually increasing difficulty keeps it engaging.

The game is perfect for relaxing: easy gameplay, pleasant visual style and engaging levels help you unwind and take your mind off things. Sometimes you’ll need to think a bit to remove all the blocks and avoid getting stuck.

Features:

Casual puzzle game
Logic and thinking games
Puzzles with blocks and arrows
Many levels
Relaxing anti-stress gameplay
Boosters for help

If you enjoy puzzles, logic games, and casual games, try Smash the Blocks! Puzzle Challenge.

title: Kinetic Puzzle
description:
Kinetic Puzzle is a block and grid puzzle brain teaser. Blocks slide with momentum until they hit a wall, an obstacle, or another block. Drag them out through edge portals — but only if the order, direction, and dependencies line up.

Master four block types:
- Red simple — slides any direction, exits any portal.
- Yellow constrained — only moves and exits in its arrow direction.
- Blue dependent — locked until its prerequisite block leaves the board.
- Gray obstacle — fixed walls that block momentum.

Features:
- 50++ hand-crafted levels, ramping from gentle slides to multi-step dependency chains
- Slide momentum mechanics — every push counts
- Neo-brutalism art style with chunky tiles and tactile feedback
- No timers, no ads mid-puzzle
- Auto-save progress, undo, and hint support
- Plays great on mobile, tablet, and desktop
- Perfect for puzzle fans who like to think before they move.

title: Slidey: Sliding Cat Puzzle
description:
Slide, Solve, and Smile with Slidey: Sliding Cat Puzzle!
Welcome to Slidey, a heartwarming sliding cat puzzle game that brings you cozy vibes, playful challenges, and the fluffiest kittens ever! ?

We give you Slidey: Sliding Cat Puzzle, the ultimate sliding block puzzle game with unique gameplay and endless fun!

The Slidey is simple: slide cute cat blocks left or right to create and clear full lines. The Slidey is free to play and easy to learn.

With no timers, no stress, and no pressure - just you, charming puzzles, and adorable feline friends - this game is your perfect escape from the daily grind.

FEATURES:
● A new type of brain training puzzle, entertain your brain for minutes or hours
● Endless challenge, you can play forever yet you'll still find something undiscovered

title: Jelly Merge: Dooper
description: Welcome to the wonderful world of Jelly Merge. Slide colorful jellies across the board, merge all jelly elements into one, and solve each level with smart moves. Plan carefully, avoid obstacles, and try to finish each puzzle in the fewest steps possible.

title: Emoji Memory: Find a Pair
description:
You need to turn over the cards, trying to find pairs of identical ones.

If two different cards are turned over, they are automatically turned back over, giving the player a little time to memorize them.

The level will be completed when the player opens all pairs of cards in the playing field.

There are two additional game modes in which you can set records by competing with other players: for time and for the minimum number of moves.

title: Emoji Memory: Find a Pair
description:
You need to turn over the cards, trying to find pairs of identical ones.

If two different cards are turned over, they are automatically turned back over, giving the player a little time to memorize them.

The level will be completed when the player opens all pairs of cards in the playing field.

There are two additional game modes in which you can set records by competing with other players: for time and for the minimum number of moves.

title: Jigmerge Puzzles
description:
Rearrange picture fragments, connect matching pieces and restore beautiful images. Relaxing and satisfying puzzles for all ages with endless level variety.

Jigmerge Puzzles is a calm and satisfying puzzle game where you restore images that have been split into shuffled picture tiles. Each level gives you a new photo broken into fragments that you can freely move, swap and connect. Analyze details, match shapes and watch the picture gradually come to life.

The game includes many themes: animals, nature, food, winter, cars, landscapes and more. Every level features a unique image, and the library of pictures grows over time. Tiles automatically “merge” when placed correctly, creating smooth and intuitive gameplay.

Jigmerge Puzzles is perfect for players who enjoy relaxing experiences, visual challenges and the satisfying moment when everything falls into place. You can play endlessly — levels cycle through the theme, and new images are added regularly. A great way to unwind, improve focus and enjoy beautiful visuals.

title: Fit Master 3D
description: Fit Master 3D is a fun online puzzle game focused on arranging food items into matching boxes. No downloads or sign-ups are required. Enjoy the challenge with burgers, fries, and more across various devices. Each level offers tasty twists and a unique sorting experience.

title: 100 Doors Puzzle Box
description:
100 Doors  Puzzle Box is an exciting puzzle and escape room game where every level brings a new challenge, mysterious doors, and hidden secrets.

Explore rooms, search for hidden objects, combine items, and solve clever puzzles to unlock the next door. Some challenges require logic, attention, and creative thinking.

Inspired by classic “100 Doors” and “escape room” games, this version features modern 3D graphics, smooth animations, and fun interactive mechanics.

Features:
• Dozens of unique levels
• Hidden object gameplay
• Interactive puzzles
• Escape room atmosphere
• Modern 3D graphics
• Easy controls
• Challenging brain teasers

Can you open all the doors?

title: Square Sort
description:
The game involves swiping colorful cubes in any direction to clear the board. The objective is to sort the squares by color, and the game gets progressively harder with each level.
The user interface is simple and easy to use, with visually appealing graphics that are pleasing to the eye. The game has a relaxing soundtrack that complements its challenging gameplay. Square Sort offers a great way to exercise your brain while having fun, and it's perfect for those who enjoy puzzle games. The game is free to download and play, with no in-app purchases or ads to interrupt the gameplay.

title: Connect: Monsters
description: Connect: Monsters is a fun online puzzle game that enhances your mental skills through monster matching. Compete with friends to achieve high scores on various platforms without needing to download anything, offering enjoyable gameplay whether you're at home or traveling.

title: TetraDice–Merge & Blast Blocks
description: Play TetraDice – Match & Build Blocks, a free puzzle game blending Tetris and dice mechanics! Strategically place dice-based shapes, clear lines, and challenge your logic. Enjoy Normal & Endless Modes, unique levels, and addictive gameplay. Start playing now!

title: Cargo Path Puzzle
description:
Cargo Path Puzzle is a free puzzle-platformer that puts your logic and movement skills to the test. Navigate tricky levels filled with deadly voids, collapsing blocks, trampolines, ice slides, and directional blocks.
Your goal: collect all the keys to activate the exit portal—then reach it to win.
Each level has only one correct solution, so plan your moves carefully. One wrong step can trap you or block your progress.
If you enjoy clever puzzles, single-solution challenges, and smart platforming, Cargo Path Puzzle is made for you.

title: Checkmate
description: Step into the world of Checkmate, a strategic chess-inspired game featuring 500 unique maps and 24 challenging achievements. Engage in intense battles on diverse boards, each requiring a fresh approach. As black squares off against white, aim for the elusive checkmate and prove your mastery. Whether youre a chess pro or a newcomer, the game offers an accessible interface for all skill levels. Unlock achievements, explore diverse maps, and experience the thrill of outsmarting your opponent in this ultimate game of kings and queens. Check and mate your way to victory!

title: PathFinder
description: PathFinder is an engaging 2D puzzle game where players dig tunnels to guide colored balls to fit into pipes beneath the surface. Each level presents unique challenges, including obstacles like metal blocks and thorns that require strategic thinking to navigate. As you progress through the 30 levels, the puzzles become increasingly complex, demanding careful planning and problem-solving skills. For every casual gamer or a puzzle fan, PathFinder will provide hours of entertaining gameplay.

title: Emoji Solitaire
description:
Welcome to Emoji Solitaire, a fresh, captivating puzzle game that beautifully marries the timeless rules of classic solitaire with clever word-association mechanics.
Instead of traditional suits like Hearts and Spades, you deal cards featuring vibrant words and stunning emojis representing categories like Animals, Food, Music, Space, Weather, Sports, and Nature. Your objective is to declutter the playing field by matching and stacking related words onto their dedicated category foundation piles.
Starting with simple piles, the puzzle complexity expands as you unlock new levels, bringing blocker cards, locked cards, and intricate category boards. Perfect for casual gaming sessions, language learners, and puzzle enthusiasts alike, Emoji Solitaire offers a tranquil, deeply satisfying spatial sorting experience.

title: Assemble Factory Puzzle
description: Play Assemble Factory Puzzle, a free online game where you solve challenging assembly line puzzles. Strategically place machines to craft perfect car parts. Test your logic, speed, and problem-solving skills in every level!

title: Cars Vs Blocks
description:
Welcome to Cars & Blocks — a fun and satisfying color-match puzzle game where strategy meets smooth driving!

Tap to blast colorful blocks and free the matching stickmen.
Each stickman must enter the car with the same color.
Clear the path, avoid traffic chaos, and make sure every car drives away safely!

It starts simple… but don’t get too comfortable 😏
As you progress, levels become more challenging with tighter spaces, more colors, and smarter puzzles that test your logic.

Game Features 🚗
• Addictive color-matching gameplay
• Easy tap controls
• Satisfying block blast effects
• Smooth stickman animations
• Challenging levels with increasing difficulty
• Clean and colorful visuals

Think fast. Plan smart. Clear the blocks.
Can you master every level and create the perfect traffic flow?🚀

title: SpeedMatch Competition
description: A competitive fast-paced tile-matching & puzzle competition. Put your stakes on speed, accuracy or both to come on top of your opponents.

title: Crash Control
description: Experience the thrilling challenge of managing traffic in Crash Control. This free online game tests your ability to maintain order at busy intersections with easy one-tap controls and impressive 3D graphics. Can you ensure safety amidst growing complexities? Jump into the action and discover your skills!

title: Constella - single line puzzle
description:
Starlight - Single Line Drawing Puzzles
Relax and unwind as you connect the stars to reveal beautiful constellations in this calming, line-complete puzzle experience. Journey through a serene celestial atmosphere where every single-line puzzle you solve brings a new shape to life. Draw your continuous path through the cosmos to discover hidden figures—from a peaceful desert cactus and a crisp apple, to a majestic celestial turtle and a starry crab. Enjoy a tranquil game that gently challenges your mind while soothing your soul.

title: Pop Sweet Fruits
description:
🎉 Dive into a fruit-filled adventure with Pop Sweet Fruits! 🍍🍑
🎮 Start with 2 fruits, pop more 💥 to unlock new ones 🔓 and boost your strength 🚀!
🔫 Upgrade bullet speed ⚡, fire rate 🔥, and earnings 💰!
🌍 Play worldwide with 7 languages (🇹🇷🇬🇧🇩🇪🇮🇹🇪🇸🇫🇷🇷🇺)!
🍒 Sweet fruits 🍇, quick reflexes ⏱️, and endless action await you! 🌀

title: Logic Islands
description: A logic puzzle game inspired by Nurikabe and Islands of Insight. Create islands with exact numbers while keeping walls connected. Navigate through 6 unique worlds with different rulesets - from Classic Nurikabe to advanced mechanics like Yin-Yang connectivity. Each world introduces new challenges with ice blocks, one-way arrows, and special orb mechanics across 240 hand-picked puzzles.

title: Magic Potion School For Witch
description: Magic Potion School for Witch is an enchanting match-3 puzzle game where young witches cast spells with a wand to connect and pop numbered magical bubbles and shapes like triangles and squares in a bubbling cauldron, mastering potion brewing through increasingly challenging levels in a whimsical wizarding academy.

title: Electron dash
description:
Attract. Repel. Survive.

Master the invisible forces of physics in this high speed magnetic arcade game. You do not just run, you glide, slam, and swing using the power of magnetism.

Use the polarity slider to instantly switch your charge between Red and Blue. Repel off walls to launch yourself across the map, or attract toward magnetic pillars to drift around tight corners.

Key Features:
Unique Control System: Master the polarity slider to push and pull your way to victory.

Physics Based Movement: Feel the momentum as you squish into walls and rocket through open spaces.

title: Block Sculptor
description:
Block Sculptor is a 3D puzzle game where you become the sculptor. Inside every block hides a colorful shape — your goal is to carefully remove all the extra gray cubes without touching the shape itself.
The challenge grows steadily: shapes get bigger, and the margin for error gets smaller. Rotate the block, study it from every angle, and think through every move!

title: Draw Dot Picture Game
description: Welcome to Draw One Miss Part Brain Games, the addictive puzzle game where logic, drawing, and brain games come together! Think you’re good at spotting details? Test your skills by identifying the missing part in each scene, and use your finger to draw it back in. Sounds simple? These brain puzzles are trickier than you think!

title: Sheep Escape: Farm Sorting Challenge
description:
Sheep Escape: Farm Sorting Challenge is an exciting casual puzzle game about a farm full of animals! Help the sheep find their way out and make a great escape from the farm.

On the field you will see sheep that can move only in straight lines. Think ahead, plan your moves, and guide the animals along the correct path to clear the field and complete the level.

Each level is a new challenge: more sheep, more obstacles, and trickier combinations. Use logic and strategy to solve farm puzzle tasks and help every animal escape.

Game features:
• Simple and intuitive sorting mechanics
• Fun and challenging puzzle levels
• Cute sheep and a cozy farm atmosphere
• Relaxing casual gameplay
• Interesting logic challenges

Are you ready to help the sheep escape? Solve farm puzzles and complete all the levels!

[Core Gameplay & Story]

Q: What is the game about and what do you do?

A: It's a casual puzzle game about animals on a farm. Your goal is to help the sheep escape from the farm.

Q: What is the main hook of the game? What makes it stand out to players?

A: It features simple and intuitive sorting mechanics, unique puzzle levels, adorable sheep, and a relaxing farm atmosphere perfect for casual play.

[Mechanics & Progression]

Q: How does the progression system work? What’s the best way to level up faster?

A: Progression is level-based; you can earn extra coins by watching ads after completing a level to speed up your progress.

[Economy & Customization]

Q: What types of currency are in the game and what can they be spent on?

A: The game uses coins, which can be spent on boosters to help clear levels as well as various character skins.

Q: Are there in-app purchases? What can you buy and how do they affect the game?

A: Yes, the game features in-app purchases that allow you to buy boosters and coins to assist with your progress.

Q: Does the game offer customization? Can you change the appearance of your character, environments, or vehicles?

A: Yes, you can purchase clothing for the sheep, trail effects for when they run, and different skins for the fields and roads.

[Retention & Engagement]

Q: Are there leaderboards? How do you climb the ranks and what types are available?

A: Yes, you can climb the leaderboards by completing as many levels as possible.

Q: Is it better to play with sound for immersion, or can the game be played without it?

A: While the music enhances the overall atmosphere and complements the gameplay, it is not required to complete the levels.

title: This is Blast
description:
Ready to blast your way through puzzles? Welcome to This is Blast, the exciting blast game that combines colorful puzzles, explosive chain reactions, and addictive ball blast mechanics. If you’re searching for a fun, free, and challenging puzzle blast game, you’ve found it.

From the very first shot, This is Blast delivers an experience that is simple to play yet packed with depth. Aim carefully, unleash your balls, and trigger epic blasts that clear the board in a single swoop. With intuitive controls, smooth visuals, and clever puzzles, this game keeps you hooked whether you want a quick session or hours of puzzle-blasting fun.

title: Max: The secret of Grandpa's letter
description:
A treasure hunt quest. Meet Max, a young wolf who dreams of adventure. One day, Max receives a letter from his late grandfather, who, like any good grandfather, always loved to play riddles with his grandson. Even after he passed away. With the letter, Max receives a treasure map and mysterious clues from his grandfather's old notebook. This means it's time to pack a backpack and embark on a journey!
Embarking on an exciting journey, our friendly wolf cub will face simple yet fun challenges. Max's path leads to the mysterious Island of Lost Ships, where the routes of sailors end and the adventures of true treasure hunters begin! 
With enthusiasm and a wagging tail, Max sets out to find his grandfather's treasure. Are you ready to unravel mysteries and become true adventurers alongside him? Let's embark on a new journey of discovery!

title: Tangram Triangle
description: Tangram Triangle is a captivating mobile puzzle game that reimagines the classic tangram tradition with triangular blocks, challenging players to drag and rotate colorful pieces—blue, yellow, red, and orange—to perfectly fill irregular silhouettes on a grid. Its core idea revolves around spatial reasoning and problem-solving, blending accessibility for all ages with progressively tougher levels and a time-attack mode for high-score chases, making it uniquely addictive through clean visuals, hundreds of puzzles, and family-friendly brain-teasing fun.

title: Flag Merging Game - Puzzle Game
description: Are you ready to discover the flags of the world? 🌍 With 8 language options (English, Russian, French, Turkish, Spanish, German, Italian, and Portuguese), 75 challenging levels await you. Beat the clock by grabbing and dropping the flags that appear 🎮, then merge two identical flags to clear the target ones! 🎯 As each level gets harder, you can unlock 12 mysterious achievements 🕵️‍♂️ and power up with two upgrades: increase your coin rewards 💰 and gain extra starting time ⏳. Show your strategy, speed, and reflexes to become the ultimate flag master! 🏆

title: Traffic Puzzle Game Linky
description: Traffic Puzzle Game Linky is a captivating logic puzzle game set in a lush forest meadow, where players connect pairs of numbered construction blocks with precisely the exact count of road segments—no more, no less—to link all cities and clear the board within time limits, earning stars and trophies in increasingly challenging levels tracked by a dynamic timer and handy undo feature.

title: Heroic knight
description: Heroic Knight is an engaging puzzle adventure game where you guide a valiant knight through treacherous terrains to achieve glory and seize hidden treasures. This free-to-play, browser-based game requires no download or registration, allowing you to dive directly into an epic medieval quest. Strategically maneuver through obstacles, outsmart cunning traps, and vanquish formidable foes on your journey. The game's captivating 2D world is perfect for fans of mind-bending puzzles and adventurous escapades, offering a seamless experience on both desktop and mobile platforms.

title: Toytopia
description: Toytopia is a cozy merge game where you are tasked to combine and produce art materials which you can use to fix broken toys. Each toy presents a unique challenge and difficulty.

title: Move Emoji
description:
Move Emoji Match Puzzle

Welcome to Move Emoji Puzzle! In this game, your task is to match emojis by moving them around. You have to think carefully because you only get a certain number of moves to solve each puzzle. 

Be smart about using your moves! If you use up all your moves and haven't cleared the puzzle, you'll lose the level. The goal is to match all the emoji boxes to clear the level and move on to the next fun challenge!

title: Pop Balloon
description: Pop Balloon is an exhilarating and fast-paced arcade game that combines precision with rapid reflexes. In this game, players are challenged to pop as many balloons as possible using a set of bouncing spikes. The objective is simple yet addictive: aim and launch the spikes in such a way that they hit and burst the balloons scattered across the screen.

title: Eco Block Puzzle
description: Discover the intriguing realm of Eco Block Puzzle, where strategy and environmental healing converge. Solve complex puzzles to cleanse the planet and earn eco coins, introducing new life to the restored valley. Enjoy this unique blend of traditional puzzles and eco-friendly play on your device. Join the journey of creativity and restoration!

title: Art'N Ball
description:
Art'N Ball is a mix between classic tennis and 3D platform game. The player will travel different locations within the Art’N Ball rolling-out world, skillfully returning his Earth-ball to have it pass walls, art exhibits, photo and puzzle challenges to finally set it free from its enclosed gallery pathway into infinite Space. 

He will experience different levels of complexity as the Earth-ball takes him from countryside or mountainous territories to the inner bowels of the underground, the depths of the seas, past frantic cityscapes towards arty lush landscapes and onto a surprise finish journey in orbit…

title: Hex Mine 3D
description:
Hex Mine 3D is a relaxing yet strategic puzzle game where every move matters. Explore beautiful spherical hex worlds, clear the correct tiles, and solve carefully designed levels with logic, focus, and precision.
Each level presents a unique hex-tile pattern wrapped around a 3D globe. Your goal is simple: analyze the board, make smart choices, and complete the puzzle without mistakes. As levels progress, the layouts become more challenging with larger patterns, trickier tile placement, and deeper strategy.
Rotate, inspect, and solve each hex puzzle at your own pace. Easy to understand, satisfying to play, and challenging to master.

Features
Unique 3D hex puzzle gameplay
Beautiful globe-style puzzle boards
Carefully designed level-based progression
Simple controls and clean visual style
Increasing difficulty across many handcrafted levels
Relaxing but brain-teasing puzzle experience
Perfect for short play sessions or focused puzzle solving

title: Colors&Forms
description: Colors&Forms is a thrilling online game that tests your reflexes and strategy. Enjoy a variety of entertaining puzzles and colorful designs without any downloads. With different game modes available, you’ll find countless challenges to complete as you progress through the levels.

title: Liquid Sort
description:
Dive into a calming yet addictive puzzle experience where every move matters.

In this trendy liquid sort game, your goal is simple: organize colorful liquids into the right containers. But don’t be fooled—each level brings new challenges that test your logic, planning, and attention to detail.

Watch vibrant colors flow smoothly as you pour, stack, and solve your way through increasingly satisfying puzzles. Whether you’re looking to relax your mind or sharpen your thinking, this game strikes the perfect balance between chill vibes and brain-teasing fun.

Features:
• Smooth and satisfying liquid animations
• Hundreds of handcrafted levels
• Easy to learn, tricky to master
• No time limits—play at your own pace
• Clean, modern visuals with a relaxing atmosphere

Can you master the art of sorting?

title: Viaducts
description:
Viaducts - Relaxing Zen Puzzle Game

Embark on a serene journey with Viaducts, the latest trending cozy, and meditative puzzle game designed to transport you into a world of calm challenges and scenic landscapes. Immerse yourself in the perfect blend of relaxation and strategy as you craft seamless paths for trains and objects using a limited number of attempts.

Viaducts is more than just a puzzle game;

It's a mindful escape into a world where challenges are met with grace, and success is achieved through thoughtful contemplation. Let the rhythmic flow of trains and the gentle rotation of bridge blocks guide you through this truly relaxing and trending gaming experience.

title: Animal Blocks
description: Animal Blocks is a delightful fusion of block puzzle mechanics and charming animal-themed visuals. Crafted for casual fun, this game offers a colorful and relaxing experience perfect for quick play sessions or winding down.

title: Bottle Color Match Challenge
description:
Your task is simple but thrillingly challenging: arrange the bottles so that the colors match! Move, combine, and find matches to complete the level.

✨ Why will you love it?
✔ Simple yet addictive – easy to start, hard to stop!
✔ Vibrant graphics – pleasing colors and smooth animations.
✔ Relax or challenge yourself – play for fun or race against the clock.
✔ Perfect for all ages – fun for the whole family!

Can you beat all the levels? Test your wits and become a true Bottle Master! 🏆

👉 Start playing right now! 👈

title: Noob: Big Item Sorting
description:
Do you enjoy keeping things tidy? Do you enjoy sorting things?

Then this game is for you! Introducing a fun new game all about sorting and cleaning!

😻In this exciting puzzle, you'll find identical objects and match them together. Arrange the objects so that two identical ones end up next to each other and form a double.

🎁Match items in pairs to advance through the levels!
Cleaning has never been so enjoyable and exciting!

🎮"Noob: The Big Object Sorting Game" is a light and calming game suitable for anyone who loves order, regardless of age or gender!

title: Try To Count The Boxes Brain Training
description:
Challenge your memory, speed and attention in "Try To Count The Boxes Brain Training". Watch boxes appear, remember the count, then submit your guess faster and more accurate each round wins.

Enjoy single-player focus mode or competitive rounds vs local friend or multiplayer. Simple tap controls, short rounds, addictive replayability perfect for quick brain workouts on desktop and mobile.

Train memory, logic, agility and reaction time now!

title: Block Puzzle: Prize Mania
description:
A classic block-drop puzzle that transforms into a true collector’s experience!

Drag pieces onto the grid, clear lines, and enjoy satisfying combos. But the real hook? 32 unique collectible items with awesome abilities.
Before each match, you build your loadout: pick up to three items that work together.

One boosts your score, another lets you blast blocks, and a third changes the board rules. Every combination delivers a fresh, highly engaging playstyle.

All items are pulled from the gacha machine. Use a ticket, pull the lever, and feel the thrill as a capsule rolls out and pops open to reveal your newest gear.

title: Voxel Master
description:
A 3D puzzle and builder in one! Assemble volumetric models from colored blocks using hints, or create your own masterpieces in sandbox mode.


Two game modes:
- Puzzle mode — hundreds of levels with increasing difficulty. You're shown a model and must recreate it block by block.
- Sandbox — free 3D modeling on grids of various sizes. Save your creations and share them with friends.

title: DOP Fun: Delete One Part
description:
Play the popular logic game DOP Fun: Delete One Part! This game invites you to use logic to tackle engaging and smart puzzles, each erasure unveiling new secrets. Prepare to become a true detective as you explore images and uncover the hidden mysteries behind them. Get ready for each level to surprise you with unexpected plot twists!  

Simple and clear gameplay makes DOP Fun: Delete One Part the perfect choice for anyone looking for quality entertainment. Simply swipe the eraser across the screen to remove parts of the drawing and discover what is hidden behind it. The game is suitable for both children and adults, enhancing skills in critical thinking and attention to detail.  

Enjoy the colorful graphics and creative challenges that will keep you entertained. It strengthens mental abilities and provides tons of fun for players of all ages.

title: Pirate Cannon A Mega Battle
description: Pirate Cannon A Mega Battle is a thrilling pirate-themed bubble shooter puzzle game where players fire numbered cannonballs from a mega cannon at the bottom to match and sink clusters of enemy hex-shaped pirate boats bearing the same numbers floating above the water, conquering challenging levels in an epic sea battle.

title: Worms
description: Worms Puzzle is a fun and relaxing puzzle game where you help cute, colorful worms find their way across small tile boards. Just swipe to move, collect dots, and reach the goal — it’s easy to learn but gets more interesting as you play! With bright visuals and bite-sized levels, it’s perfect for quick breaks or winding down anytime.

title: 21 Rush - Ultimate Card Game
description:
Welcome to 21 Rush : Ultimate Card Game - A smart, fast paced card challenge that blends the thrill of Blackjack with the strategic depth of Solitaire. Designed for both casual fun and competitive mastery, 21 Rush rewards sharp thinking, quick decisions, and clever Combos!

A single game takes only just few minutes... but chasing high scores and perfect runs will keep you hooked for hours!

🧠 Easy to Learn. Hard to Master.
Whether you’re an aspiring card counter or a casual card lover, 21 Rush offers a perfectly balanced experience:
• Play relaxed games at your own pace
• Or push your limits and compete for the highest scores
Every move matters. One wrong card can change everything.


⭐ KEY FEATURES:

✅ Fast & Addictive Gameplay
• Play quick matches on the go, at home, or while travelling.

✅ Strategic TRASH Button
• Skip dangerous cards and avoid busting critical lanes.

✅ High-Score Driven Design
• Chase Streaks, lane bonuses, and perfect plays to beat your personal best.

✅ Challenge Mode
• Face fresh challenges that introduce new twists every time you play.

✅ Helpful Tips & Tricks
• Learn advanced strategies through the in-game Help section.

✅ Smooth Touch Controls
• Optimized for Android mobiles & PC with responsive controls.

✅ Fast Loading & Smooth Animations
• Lightweight, polished, and performance-friendly.

✅ Customization Options
• Unlock and customize card backs and background themes.

✅ Blackjack-Inspired Fun
• Enjoy the essence of Blackjack in a brand-new strategic format.

🏆 Can You Master the Rush to 21?
• Perfect your strategy.
• Chain massive combos.
• Climb higher with every run.

Play 21 Rush - your Ultimate Card game now!

title: Sweet Flip
description: Match delicious cakes of the same color, clear the board, and earn points! Unlock new flavors and increase the challenge as you progress. A simple yet addictive puzzle game with bright, tasty desserts.

title: Stack Swipe
description:
Welcome to Stack Swipe, a colorful puzzle game where every swipe brings you closer to satisfying chain reactions!
Swipe to shift entire rows or columns and stack same colored plates.
Match at least 5 plates in one stack to trigger a blast and work your way toward the level’s target!

title: Line Control
description:
Line Control is a tactical game about routes, bases, and quick decisions. Draw lines from your points to neutral and enemy positions, send squads, and gradually take control of the map.

Every level is a new logic challenge. Sometimes you need to capture free points quickly, sometimes you must defend key positions, and sometimes one smart route can change the whole match. The more bases you control, the stronger your advantage becomes.

Simple controls make the game easy to start, while growing difficulty keeps every level tactical and engaging.

title: Zestful Match
description:
Dive into a vibrant and refreshing tile-matching adventure with Zestful Match! Challenge your focus and strategy as you match three identical fruit tiles to clear the board. With juicy animations and premium aesthetics, it's the perfect game for quick sessions or hours of fun.

Key Features:

Juicy Match-3 Gameplay: Simple mechanics with satisfying visual effects.
Powerful Boosters: Stuck? Use Undo, Hint, or Shuffle to keep the game going.
Competitive Leaderboards: See how you rank against players worldwide!
Achievement System: Unlock medals for your skill and progress.
Fully Responsive: Flawless experience across mobile and desktop devices.

title: Draw & Drop
description: Dive into the thrilling universe of Draw & Drop, where creativity and skill collide! Navigate the ball into a basket by sketching your route, while overcoming tricky obstacles. Test your ingenuity through various levels, available for free on both mobile and desktop. Enjoy the challenge!

title: Bounce Heroes
description: Bounce Heroes is a thrilling blend of idle RPG, merge puzzle, and roguelite action where your hero battles fierce monsters, an evil empire, and ancient beasts, all in pursuit of treasure and victory. Armed with a trusty crossbow and magical bouncy balls dropped by fallen foes, you’ll crush enemies wave after wave.

title: Fillblox
description:
An engaging logic puzzle where your goal is to fill the playing field with shapes. You're given several blocks of different forms — drag each one into place so that not a single cell is left empty. Sounds simple? With every level, the board gets larger and the pieces grow more numerous and more intricate.

An adaptive difficulty system adjusts to your pace — if you're blazing through levels too quickly, the game will throw a tougher challenge your way. Stuck? Use a hint to automatically place one piece in the right spot.

title: Extreme Balancer
description: Extreme Balancer is an exciting and challenging game where you have to balance a ball on narrow wooden bridges and guide it safely to the end of each level.
