Be careful, if the ball falls off, you will have to start over! The game has beautiful 3D graphics and realistic physics that make it feel like you are really balancing the ball.

title: Container Auction
description:
"Container Auction" — an exciting auction simulator! Bid on mysterious containers, competing against rivals. Peek inside through the door gap, assess the contents, and place your bid!

Open containers and discover items — from old books to gold watches and diamond brooches. Every item has its own rarity: common, uncommon, rare, epic, or legendary!

title: 248 Scribble
description: 248 Scribble is a casual mobile merge puzzle game inspired by 2048, where players connect adjacent dots with matching numbers (like 2s, 4s, or 8s) horizontally or vertically on a colorful grid to merge them into higher values, aiming to achieve 248 while managing space and earning coins—its unique "scribble" art style with hand-drawn, vibrant, doodle-like tiles and intuitive touch controls sets it apart as an addictive, relaxing brain teaser.

title: SUM+SUM
description: Match the numbers. The numerical grid awaits your solution. Your task is to retain only those numbers that add up to the desired horizontal and vertical values. Eliminate the unnecessary, maintain balance, and uncover the logic behind each move

title: Merge Emoji Arena
description: Merge Emoji Arena is an addictive casual idle-merge game where your favorite emojis come to life to battle! Build your ultimate army by purchasing basic emojis, merging identical ones to evolve them into stronger fighters, and deploying them to the front lines. What makes this game unique is its seamless blend of satisfying puzzle-merging with hands-free idle combat—your deployed emojis will continuously fight and farm gold for you even while you have the game running in the background!

title: Puzzle Candle
description:
Your goal is simple: Reach the end of each level -- but getting there won't be easy.
Solve tricky puzzles and master precise platforming to clear the stages. Use a variety of helpful items to turn the challenge in your favor and find clever ways to progress.
Explore a total of 50 levels set in different environments, each offering new obstacles and surprises.

title: The Goopies: Slime Puzzle
description: Casual 2D puzzle game where you guide slimes safely to the exit. Instead of controlling them directly, you place simple instructions on a grid to change how they move.

title: Domino Camp
description:
🀄 Domino Camp is a fun and addictive puzzle game where strategy meets quick thinking! Match domino tiles, clear the board, and complete exciting challenges across a variety of levels. With simple controls, smooth gameplay, and satisfying matches, Domino Camp offers endless entertainment for players of all ages.

🎯 Test your logic, improve your matching skills, and discover new ways to solve each puzzle. Whether you're looking for a relaxing experience or a brain-teasing challenge, Domino Camp is the perfect place to start your domino adventure! ✨

Features:
🀄 Easy-to-learn gameplay
🎮 Challenging puzzle levels
✨ Smooth animations and satisfying effects
🏆 Fun challenges and rewarding progression
🌟 Suitable for all ages

Join the camp and become a domino master in Domino Camp! 🚀🀄

title: Hexholm
description:
Hexholm is a fast, turn-based hex strategy game. Start from a single province and carve out a kingdom — recruit troops, claim the map hex by hex, and crush rival AI factions before they overrun you. Every battle is a tight tactical puzzle: manage your gold, position your units, and time your pushes to expand without overextending.

Take on 100 hand-picked campaign stages, fight for the top of the global leaderboard in the daily challenge, or jump into a quick random skirmish. Climb the worldwide rankings for total stages cleared and daily high scores.

No fluff, no waiting — just clean, snappy strategy you can play in a few minutes or sink hours into.

title: Escaping Arrows
description:
Ready to test your logic in a game where every move matters? Escaping Arrows is a minimalistic and deep puzzle game in which you have to untangle a complex knot of directions and paths.

The essence of the game is simple: there are arrows on the field, and your goal is to remove them all one by one.

What awaits you inside:

– 100 skill levels: Test yourself with tasks ranging from elementary to truly complex mazes.

– Special challenges: Every 5th level tests your skills with increased difficulty.

– The game is perfect for both short breaks and long evening sessions thanks to its anti-stress effect and smooth progression of difficulty.

Can you clear the field without making a single mistake? Test yourself in Escaping Arrows! Good luck!

title: Shape Ascent - Roguelite
description: Shape Ascent is a strategic puzzle game inspired by 2048, where you merge geometric shapes on a 5×5 grid to reach the legendary Ascent Crown. Starting with simple Triangles and Squares, you'll combine matching shapes by swiping in four directions — merging them into Pentagons, Hexagons, Stars, Crystals, Essences, and ultimately the Ascent Crown (8128). What makes Shape Ascent unique is its roguelike card system: every few moves, you're offered a choice of Power Cards with Common, Rare, and Epic abilities — from Score Boosts and Merge Bonuses to Emergency Saves and Auto-Cleanse effects that permanently alter your run. Manage your Undo charges, use the Remove Tile tool wisely, and plan every swipe to avoid filling the board. With 13 shape tiers, stackable card effects, milestone celebrations, and a save system that lets you continue where you left off, Shape Ascent blends classic merge puzzle satisfaction with strategic depth and replayability. Available in 6 languages.

title: Flows
description:
Flows is a cozy logic puzzle about sorting colored liquids between flasks. Tap one flask, then another, to pour the top color — your goal is to leave every flask filled with a single color (or empty).

✨ Features:
• 40 hand-tuned levels with a smooth difficulty curve
• Per-level time leaderboards — race the world for the fastest solve
• Optional hint system (rewarded ad)
• Clean minimalist visuals, calming palette
• Plays in 4 languages: English, Русский, Español, Português
• No accounts, no timers, no pressure — pick up and play

Perfect for short coffee breaks or long focused sessions.

title: Copy the Drawing
description:
An exciting drawing game with hundreds of levels! Look at the example and recreate the drawing on the canvas — the more accurate, the higher your score.

The game features 300 levels across 18 categories: from simple shapes to animals, transport, space, fantasy, and Japanese culture. Every day brings a new drawing of the day — build your streak and compete with yourself!

Three brush sizes, undo last stroke, hints, and a medal system — all designed to make drawing fun and enjoyable. Gold, silver, or bronze — which medal will your drawing earn?

title: JigRot
description: JigRot is a chill puzzler: drag scattered pieces, snap them together, and merge clusters until the full crazy brainrot picture locks in. Easy to learn, smooth to play, and built for a relaxing flow — one oddball pack after another when you want to unwind without pressure.

title: Sand Tetris Pro
description:
Sand Tetris Pro is a fresh take on the classic Tetris formula with realistic sand physics. When tetrominoes land, they crumble into hundreds of sand particles that behave like real sand, filling the level in dynamic and unpredictable ways. Instead of simply clearing rows, you must think about the flow of sand and how piles form and collapse.

The game features two main modes: Endless Mode and Campaign Mode, which includes hundreds of levels with objectives and up to three stars to earn for completing challenges.

Key features include dynamic sand physics, unique power-ups (bomb — destroys a large area; vacuum — removes accumulated sand; slow motion — gives you extra time to place pieces precisely), in-game currency, a booster shop, and a progression system.

title: 2048 Knights
description: 2048 Knights is a puzzle twist on the classic 2048. Slide your knights across the board, merge matching numbers to forge stronger units, and reach the goal in as few moves as you can. Every level is hand-crafted — plus daily challenges and 60-second time trials to keep you coming back.

title: Cube Quiz
description: CubeQuiz is a relaxing 3D spatial-reasoning puzzle. Two sandy voxel blocks fit together when one slides down and the other slides up to form a solid box. Rotate the pieces, read their shapes, and decide which ones lock perfectly together. Progress through four puzzle packs of increasing difficulty, then test yourself in endless Challenge mode. No timers, no pressure — just you and your mental rotation skills.

title: Logic Storm: Animals Puzzle
description:
Logic Farm: Animal Grid Puzzle is a relaxing yet challenging logic puzzle game where your goal is to place cute animals on a grid following specific rules. With its soft pastel aesthetics and brain-teasing levels, it’s the perfect blend of cozy gaming and mental exercise. Can you find the perfect spot for every animal? Start sorting your farm today!
Key Features
•	Choose Your Pace with Two Modes:
o	Relax Mode: Enjoy a stress-free experience with no lives limit and no time pressure. Simply relax and solve puzzles at your own speed.
o	Challenge Mode: Put your logic to the test! This mode features limited lives (represented by the heart icon) and a time limit, challenging you to solve the farm layout before time runs out.
•	Interactive Tutorial: Easy-to-follow instructions guide you through your first placements, helping you learn to "cross out" cells where animals cannot be placed.
•	Helpful Tools: Use the "Find" or "Hint" features if you get stuck on a tricky arrangement.
•	Challenging Levels: Progress through increasingly difficult grids as you move from Level 1 onwards.
•	Cozy Visuals: Enjoy a clean UI and charming animal icons designed for a pleasant gaming experience.

title: Cat Block Puzzle
description:
Cat Block Puzzle is a fun and relaxing block slide puzzle game with a cute cat theme. 
In this game, you slide blocks across the board and arrange them to match the target picture. 
Every level gives you a new puzzle to solve, and each move matters. 
It is simple to start, but it becomes more challenging as the puzzles get harder.

title: Criss Cross Colors
description: Criss Cross Colors is a fun, addictive color-matching puzzle game that puts a vibrant twist on classic crosswords. Instead of letters, players drag and drop colorful blocks from the bottom palette to fill the grid, matching colors both horizontally and vertically to clear every square. With its simple one-tap drag controls, relaxing yet challenging gameplay, colorful cartoon style, daily rewards, hints, and timed levels, it delivers pure brain-teasing joy for all ages — the perfect mix of logic, color, and satisfaction!

title: Recycle Game
description:
Turn trash into order and save the planet!

Recycle Game is a relaxing and oddly satisfying waste-sorting game that combines casual fun with a meaningful eco-friendly mission. If you love cleanup games, and zen-like puzzles, this one's for you!

Why you'll love Recycle Game:
ODDLY SATISFYING GAMEPLAY – Smooth controls and calming sorting mechanics. The perfect way to de-stress after a long day.
LEARN THROUGH PLAY – Master real-life recycling rules naturally. Paper, plastic, glass, metal – you'll become an expert without even noticing!

Key Features:
• Simple controls – just drag and drop, easy for all ages
• Relaxing vibes – calm aesthetics and satisfying feedback
• Global leaderboard – compete with players around the world
• Family friendly – safe, educational, and fun for kids and adults alike
• Progressive levels – from simple tasks to challenging recycling puzzles

title: The Sort Agency
description: Take over the best sorting agency in the world! Sort fruit, cakes and toys! Find 3 identical items and they will disappear! Bring order in 1000 levels of this addictive and colorful 3D puzzle game!

title: Crystalia
description: A vibrant block puzzle game. Place pieces on the board so that 3 or more blocks of the same color line up next to each other — and watch them vanish in a satisfying explosion. Simple rules, endless depth, and a fierce battle for the top spot on the leaderboard.

title: Supa Tic Tac Toe
description:
Tic-Tac-Deck evolves the classic grid into a brutal tactical arena. Forget simple X’s and O’s—here, your hand is your weapon.
Draft powerful cards to manipulate the board, sabotage your opponent, and shatter the rules. Will you control the field or execute a game-winning combo? Every card offers a one-time, high-impact ability that turns a stalemate into a checkmate. Master the deck, claim the line.

title: Tile Matcher Triple Fun
description: Tile Matcher Triple Fun is a relaxing triple tile-matching puzzle game inspired by Mahjong Solitaire, where players tap to find and match three identical fruit-themed tiles (like peaches, blueberries, and bananas) to clear the vibrant, stacked board against a tropical beach backdrop. Its core concept revolves around strategic triple matching to conquer increasingly challenging levels, with unique vibrant fruit designs, a serene seaside theme featuring a surfer and palm islands, and helpful tools like hints and shuffles for endless addictive fun.

title: Tick-Tack-What?
description:
Think you have mastered Tic-Tac-Toe? Think again! In this mind-bending twist on the classic game, you are playing against an AI opponent that absolutely refuses to play by the rules.
As you progress through increasingly complex and irregular board shapes, the bot will use an arsenal of dirty tricks to stop you from winning. From erasing your precious X's and locking cells, to literally dropping bombs on the board and faking its own victories! You'll need to stay one step ahead of its gravity-shifting, glitching, and rule-breaking mechanics.
Can you outsmart a machine that constantly cheats? Test your logic, adapt to unpredictable board mutations, and prove that human ingenuity can beat an unfair AI!

title: Chess Royale
description: A non-standard chess game in which kings have magical powers. The player needs to cut down the enemy king, building a victorious tactics by combining the queue of moves and magical abilities.

title: Tap Away Block Puzzle 3D
description: Challenge your mind with Tap Away Block Puzzle 3D! This relaxing logic game offers a satisfying brain teaser. Your mission: tap blocks to clear the screen. It's tricky blocks only move one way! Swipe to rotate the puzzle, find the right order, and watch them fly away. Puzzles get tougher as you go, perfect for training your brain. This free-to-play 3D puzzle is your ideal mental escape. Ready for the challenge? Start tapping now!

title: Car Escape Parking
description:
🚗🅿️ Car Escape Parking is a mind-twisting puzzle adventure where every move counts! The parking lot is packed, cars are stuck, and only your brain can solve the mess 🧠💥

Slide, move, and escape! 🚘➡️ Carefully shift each vehicle in the right order to clear a path and free the trapped car without crashing into obstacles 🚧😬 Sounds easy? Think again!

Each level brings a new parking nightmare 😵‍💫 — more cars, tighter spaces, and smarter challenges that will test your logic and planning skills to the limit 🔥🧩

✨ Features you’ll love:
🚗 Tons of tricky parking puzzles
🧠 Brain-boosting gameplay
🚦 Increasing difficulty with unique layouts
😌 Satisfying and relaxing problem-solving vibes

Can you escape the ultimate parking jam and become the true Parking Master? 🏆🅿️
Start your engine and prove it! 🚀🚘

title: Bus Parking Out
description: Logic meets strategy! Operate 3 types of buses in 8 vibrant colors, each requiring careful planning. Enjoy a stunning 3D environment, as you clear the way for the selected bus and collect passengers. Master the art of optimal movement.

title: Puzzle Blocks Classic
description: Get ready for an addictive block puzzle challenge! Drag and drop colorful blocks to clear lines and rack up points. Think ahead, make big matches, and unleash powerful Super Blocks to crush multiple lines at once! Stuck? Use boosters to keep the game going. With three chances to clear the center, aim for the highest score and climb the global leaderboard. Easy to play, hard to master—can you become the ultimate puzzle champion? Let the block-dropping fun begin!

title: Thread Match
description: Immerse yourself in the world of Thread Match — a unique and exciting puzzle where you sort colorful threads to complete embroidery patterns. Unravel layers of palettes, carefully working your way down to reveal hidden threads. Use logic and strategy to avoid running out of moves. But be careful — the color palette can be tricky, and every choice matters!

title: Hexa Stack
description: Welcome to Hexa Stack—an all-new hexagon puzzle that’s equal parts relaxing and challenging. Sort colorful tiles by color, stack smart to create powerful combos, and think ahead before the board fills up. Each level adds new twists, requiring focus, memory, and clever planning. Stuck? Use boosters like swap and shuffle to keep your run alive. Simple controls, satisfying merges, and nonstop brain fun!

title: Wood Block Puzzle 3
description: Wood Block Puzzle 3 is a polished, relaxing 10×10 wooden block game featuring a fresh UI, smart boosters, and satisfying break animations. Drag shapes from the right tray, complete rows or columns to score, and chase your best record. Use boosters at the bottom—watch rewarded ads to earn coins and unlock boosters when needed. Simple to learn and hard to master, it’s perfect for quick breaks or long zen sessions.

title: Yummy Tales 3
description: Join Oscar, the clever farm dog, in Yummy Tales 3 — the fun and addictive Match 3 puzzle game! Match 3 or more fruits and veggies to feed your farm animals and reach level goals before you run out of moves. Enjoy over 2500+ exciting levels, daily missions, and challenges. Collect daily gifts, boosters, and fantastic rewards to help you beat tricky puzzles. Harvest the fun and start playing Yummy Tales 3 now!

title: Farm Blast
description: Farm Blast is a colorful level-based blast puzzle game set on a vibrant farm. Complete exciting objectives, overcome tricky obstacles, and unlock powerful boosters as you progress through hundreds of engaging levels. With bright visuals, satisfying chain reactions, and strategic gameplay, this addictive casual puzzle game is perfect for fans of match-3 games, farm games, and relaxing yet challenging brain teasers.

title: Kings and Queens Match 3
description: Step into Kings and Queens Match 3, the enchanting third chapter of the royal Match-3 adventure! Match jewels, crowns, and other royal artifacts to progress through exciting levels. Use powerful boosters like bombs, hammers, and royal blasts to clear challenging boards. Unlock new parts of the kingdom as you enjoy stunning visuals and a charming soundtrack. Join the royal quest and discover treasure, challenge, and endless fun!

title: Sorting Xmas Balls
description:
Sorting Xmas Balls is a cozy winter puzzle game where you sort colorful Christmas ornaments into their correct tubes. Move the balls, group matching colors together, and enjoy calm, festive gameplay.

As you progress, the puzzles become more challenging with more tubes and more colors to organize. Bright graphics and a cheerful holiday theme make every level relaxing and satisfying to complete.

title: Woody Hexa
description: Woody Hexa is a visually engaging puzzle game that challenges players to complete 250 levels by strategically arranging hexagonal blocks by color. With simple drag-and-drop controls and increasingly complex layouts, each level tests your logic and spatial awareness. Combining relaxing gameplay with clever merging mechanics, Woody Hexa offers a satisfying brain workout perfect for all ages.

title: Stacking Match
description: Jenga match is a very fun puzzle game. Players need to pull out blocks of a certain color from a multi-layered tower of blocks. The pulled block will fly into the corresponding colored square. When there are three blocks of the same color in a square, it will eliminated, and a new square will appear. How many levels you can play?

title: Water Sort - Collections
description: Sort, pour, and relax! Complete each level by filling bottles and unlock beautiful collectible images. Test your logic, calm your mind, and build your own gallery as you master the art of sorting water!

title: Thread Match 2
description:
Thread Match 2 is a satisfying logic puzzle game that combines color matching, layered challenges, and calming embroidery visuals.

Solve clever thread puzzles by planning the correct order of moves and dismantling complex constructions. Each level challenges your brain with blocked and unlocked elements, where strategy and attention matter more than speed.

title: Fish Story 2
description: Welcome to Fish Story 2 - the second sequel to the beloved underwater Match 3 Game coming with fresh new graphics, a catchy tune, and lots of improvements! Meet your new host, the mermaid herself who will be pleased to guide you on your adventure through incredible 2,000+ splashy levels and teach you all the tricks you need to know to solve even the most complicated puzzles.

title: Xmas Hexa Sort
description:
Xmas Hexa Sort is a festive twist on the classic hexagon puzzle!
Move and place colorful stacks of blocks on the board to create perfect combinations and clear space. Relax, think ahead, and enjoy the cozy holiday atmosphere as you solve each cheerful puzzle!

title: Big Block Blast
description:
Place triangles and blocks to build 2x2 BIG BLOCKS! Drag and drop shapes into the grid to complete full squares made of triangles. Matching colors gives you bonus points, so in Big Block Blast you must aim for smart and colorful combos!
Some blocks have special powers and can even be placed on top of others. Use them strategically to unlock new moves and clear space. Big Block Blast is a simple to play game but tricky to master! How many BIG BLOCKS can you make?

title: Thread Sort
description: Thread Sort is a relaxing and satisfying puzzle game where you organize colorful threads on spools and turn them into beautiful cross-stitched pictures. Sort mixed threads by color, clear the pegs, and watch as neatly arranged strands automatically stitch a charming image on the canvas. With cozy visuals, smooth animations, and simple controls, Thread Sort is perfect for fans of sorting puzzles, knitting games, and calming casual challenges.

title: Arrow Puzzle
description: Arrow Puzzle is a relaxing logic game that turns simple taps into a rewarding challenge. Your goal is straightforward: find a free path, tap arrows in the right order, and enjoy as the maze slowly turns into a clear, empty board. Follow the arrows to escape the puzzle and find a soothing flow that keeps your mind engaged and relaxed.

title: Farm Match Seasons 3
description: With over 2700+ levels and a relaxing soundtrack to enjoy, Farm Match Seasons 3 is a charming Match 3 game that continues the story of the beautiful farm in the village. Your friend Poppy needs your help managing the farm — harvesting strawberries, collecting flowers, and protecting butterflies in the fields. Don’t forget to keep those pesky weeds under control! This sequel comes packed with a major content update and new challenges to discover.

title: Block Wood Puzzle
description:
Drag and drop the wooden blocks to fill the gap.

Complete a row to score points. Complete 2 rows or more to score bonus points.

How high can you score?

title: Color Nuts
description:
Color Nuts is a relaxing and addictive color-matching puzzle game where you place colorful nuts on the board and connect three or more of the same color to clear them.

Plan your moves carefully, complete level objectives, and keep the board from filling up. Easy to learn and hard to master, Color Nuts is the perfect casual puzzle game for fans of match-3, block puzzles, and logic games.

title: Hexa Sort Trick or Treat
description: Step into a haunted puzzle realm where glowing hexagonal blocks hide within a web of spooky challenges. Your task: sort eerie, color-coded pieces into their rightful places before the shadows close in. With every drag and drop, you’ll sharpen your wits and unravel chillingly clever layouts that grow trickier as you progress. Easy to pick up yet devilishly addictive, this Halloween brain-teaser will keep players of all ages spellbound through hundreds of spooky levels.

title: Master Blender
description: Becoming the Strongest Bartending Master！Tap the bottle lightly to pour water. Organize the water so that each bottle's water is distributed to the corresponding colored cup!

title: Bus Escape: Clear Jam
description:
Dismantle the bus and send the passengers home in this colorful parking puzzle that delivers both fun and a brain workout. Combining simple gameplay with increasing difficulty, the game is perfect for fans of strategic puzzles and driving simulators.
Get ready for the challenge: sort the cars, find the right solutions, and free up parking spaces. Each car and bus has a limited number of seats, so plan your moves carefully to untangle the chaotic traffic jam.

title: Unblock It 3D
description:
Power up your logic and spatial reasoning skills with Unblock It 3D! Rotate the cluster of bricks to find unblocked tiles you can slide away without hitting any obstructions. 

Play Classic Mode and enjoy hundreds of intricate puzzles with unlimited moves, new cube designs and backgrounds to unlock.

Or, journey through time in Adventure Mode. Try your hand at 25 additional levels of increasing complexity and size. Explore Ancient Egypt, Medieval Europe, the Aztec Empire, feudal Japan, and more.

title: Gummy Blocks
description:
Gummy Blocks is a HTML5 Puzzle Game. Drag the forms in the free cells and clear rows and columns in the grid! 
Go ahead and try to become the best in the game!

title: Sudoku Garden
description: Players must expand their thinking to solve puzzles in adventures. Learn to approach problems from different angles and discover hidden clues and patterns to overcome challenges. These games test wit while fueling interest and challenge-seeking mentality.

title: Marble Sort
description: Marble Sort is a fun and satisfying puzzle game where colorful marbles travel along a conveyor belt waiting to be sorted. Fill matching trays, complete sets of three identical marbles, and clear every level. Plan your moves carefully, manage the flow, and enjoy smooth animations, relaxing gameplay, and rewarding sorting challenges. Easy to learn, hard to master!

title: Unblock it Atlantis
description: Dive into the underwater world of Unblock It 3D: Atlantis and test your logic with endless brain-teasing puzzles! Rotate the puzzle cube to reveal which blocks you can slide away. Discover a vast collection of levels inspired by the lost city of Atlantis, featuring stone tiles textured like coral, shimmering pearl finishes, and sea flora woven through ancient ruins. Unlock new cube styles, explore vibrant oceanic themes, and keep your mind sharp as the puzzles grow more complex.

title: Arrow Tap Puzzle
description: Arrows fill the board like traffic at a silent crossing. Some lanes are open, others blocked. Remove arrows one by one, avoid blocked paths and keep your daily streak alive. Solve the arrangement in front of you, then step into another.

title: Ball Sort
description: Ball Sort is a relaxing yet addictive color sorting puzzle. Move colorful balls between tubes and organize them by color until every tube contains only matching balls. Plan your moves carefully, use empty spaces wisely, and solve increasingly challenging levels. Easy to learn but difficult to master, Ball Sort offers satisfying gameplay that will keep your brain engaged for hours.

title: Kings and Queens Mahjong
description: Enter the magical Royal Kingdom in Kings & Queens Mahjong! Match pairs of jewels, crowns, and other royal treasures to clear the board and climb the Royal Leaderboard. Race against the clock, use boosters like Hint, Shuffle, and Undo when needed, and enjoy handcrafted tiles with a majestic design. Perfect for puzzle lovers looking for a royal challenge!

title: Jewel Coloring
description:
Jewel Coloring is a unique puzzle game where colorful gems become part of beautiful pixel-art pictures.
Sort colorful jewels, match them with the correct cells, and complete beautiful pixel-art images. Every level is a brain-teasing puzzle where the right colors must go to the right places. Solve hundreds of satisfying challenges, unlock new pictures, and transform scattered gems into sparkling masterpieces. Perfect for fans of sorting games, color matching, logic puzzles, and relaxing gameplay.

title: Shop Sorting Xmas
description: Love a well-organized, neatly arranged space? Then Shop Sorting Xmas is the perfect game for you! Step into a delightful Christmas-themed puzzle game where you’ll sort and arrange festive items in a magical Christmas toy shop. In this captivating holiday sorting game, find and match identical toys and Christmas decorations, organizing them on the shelves. Your goal is to gather three identical items together to create a triplet and clear the shelves.

title: Card Master
description: Card Master is a fun and addictive puzzle game for all ages! Strategically merge identical cards to create stronger, higher-level ones while keeping the board from filling up. Use special cards and powerful boosts to clear space and score big. With its mix of strategy, challenge, and endless replay value, it’s the perfect game for anyone who loves to think ahead and have fun.

title: Park Me: Draw Path
description: "Park Me: Draw Path" is a casual puzzle game integrating "painting + parking + puzzle solving", which adds "drawing lines" to the traditional parking gameplay, testing the player's logical thinking, spatial imagination and path planning ability, and getting an "intellectual exercise" in a short period of time.

title: Balloon Match 3D
description: Relax and enjoy this addictive ballons 3d matching game as you collect items and complete different missions.Your goal is to clear the bubble by finding and matching all ballons before the time runs out!

title: Cryptogram
description:
This game is for people who do not just look at letters but see the meaning behind them.
Each phrase hides a thought that can be revealed if you use logic, intuition and persistence.

title: Toy Match 3
description: Toy Match 3 is the third sequel to one of our cutest Match 3 puzzle games! Get ready for colorful graphics, fun animations, and a catchy soundtrack. Match adorable toys in over 4,100+ exciting levels and take on Daily Missions and Weekly Challenges! Embark on thrilling quests like the Treasure Hunt for amazing rewards. With tons of extras and surprises, Toy Match 3 is pure puzzle fun. Start playing now for free!

title: Mahjong Earth
description: Immerse yourself in the serene beauty of Mahjong Earth! This captivating game offers a tranquil escape with its soothing earth-themed soundtrack and stunning tile designs. Explore over 250+ unique puzzle layouts, each more challenging than the last. Use the Combo meter to match quickly and earn stars. Climb the leaderboard for recognition and claim boosters by reaching the top. Immerse in the relaxing soundtrack and earthy tiles for a truly calming experience!

title: Car Paint
description: Carpaint is a free, family-friendly HTML5 logic puzzle game and casual brain teaser featuring 30 vibrant color grid challenges. Guide colorful cars across a 3×3 board, leaving paint trails to match reference patterns. This addictive, cross-platform online puzzle works in any browser or on mobile - play now!

title: Color Yarn Sort
description: Color Yarn Sort is a fun and relaxing puzzle game where you need to sort colorful spools of yarn into their matching buckets. The challenge? You have limited space to place the buckets, and you must think carefully about which bucket to move forward. Each yarn color must be placed in its corresponding bucket, but you can only move the buckets into the available spaces—there’s no room for error!

title: Shop Sorting 2
description:
Love organizing and keeping things tidy? Then Shop Sorting 2 is the perfect game for you! Step into a satisfying sorting puzzle where you arrange and categorize products in a well-stocked store.
In Shop Sorting 2, the challenge shifts from organizing specialty goods to managing the variety and chaos of a busy supermarket. Test your skills as you handle groceries, household items, and more. Enjoy rewarding match and sort gameplay, unlock new products, and upgrade your store layout.

title: Bird Sort Puzzle
description: Bird Sort Puzzle - Latest free sorting puzzle game with a new art style and collection of colorful birds. Bird Sort will definitely make you enjoy it while training your brain. This sorting game stimulates your brain in a very fun and challenging way. It's easy to play with one finger control and suitable for all ages. Test your IQ by passing unique levels and unlocking new challenges. Play Bird Sort now for free and enjoy super fun challenges and awesome brain teasers!

title: Royal Crown Blast
description:
Royal Crown Blast is a colorful and relaxing casual puzzle game where you tap, blast, and clear vibrant blocks to complete each level’s goals.
Immerse yourself in a royal atmosphere as you match groups of blocks of the same color and shape, triggering spectacular explosions and powerful boosters.
With many levels, charming visuals, and simple one-tap controls, the game is both relaxing and delightfully addictive.

title: Mahjong Tile Club
description: Step into the relaxing world of Mahjong Tile Club, where timeless tile-matching meets innovative gameplay! This solitaire-style mahjong game is perfect for anyone looking for a calm yet engaging puzzle experience. With simple rules and soothing gameplay, it’s easy to pick up and hard to put down. Match identical tiles, clear the board, and enjoy a satisfying sense of accomplishment.

title: Cake Sort
description:
Cake Sort is a colorful and cozy puzzle game where you stack and sort delicious desserts to score as many points as possible! Move cakes around the table and match them by type to build perfect stacks of identical treats.
Bright graphics, smooth animations, and tasty visuals make the game relaxing, cheerful, and endlessly replayable.
Your goal is simple — keep sorting cakes and earn points for every perfect match until the table is full!

title: Color Sand Puzzle
description: Welcome to Color Sand Puzzle! Relax and unwind with Color Sand Puzzle, a refreshing take on the classic block puzzle game! Your mission is simple yet fun—fill the grid with matching colors of sand to clear and control the lines. As colorful sand blocks fall from the top, you’ll need to strategically arrange them to form complete horizontal rows. When the sand lines up from left to right, they disappear, and you earn points!

title: Fruit Sort Logic
description: Fruit Sort Logic is a fun and relaxing puzzle game where you sort colorful fruit juices on shelves. Move the juices around and match three of the same kind to clear a shelf. Space is limited, so each move matters. Clear all shelves to finish the level and unlock new ones. With smooth controls, bright visuals, and endless levels, the game is easy to play and satisfying to master. Perfect for a calm but clever puzzle experience.

title: Guess the Kitty
description: Click on the right Kitty answer or else....... your cat will suffer from the consequences. Guess the Kitty is a fun, sadistic, quiz game. Unlock all the 10 endings by getting further into the game. Make sure not to go game-over!!

title: Hidden Objects Island
description: Discover the ultimate hidden objects game and embark on a journey through stunning locations, captivating puzzles, and mysterious adventures!

title: Jewel Blocks
description: Train your brain in this addictive logical arcade challenge with classic block shapes! Play endlessly to beat your high score and collect rewards! Easy to learn and fun to master. Also with lots of skins available.

title: Traffic Tap Survival
description: Traffic Tap Survival is a fast-paced traffic puzzle game where every tap matters. Control busy intersections, avoid crashes, and guide cars through dangerous roads filled with obstacles and tight turns. With simple controls, challenging levels, and intense survival gameplay, this addictive traffic management game will test your timing and reflexes. Perfect for fans of car puzzle games, traffic control games, and casual brain challenges.

title: WordMix
description:
WordMix is a game where words hide their connections, and you uncover them.
The board is filled with word cards. Some of them share a theme, meaning, or association. Your task is to sense the link and bring the words of one group into a single row.
Sometimes the answer is obvious. Sometimes you have to think. And finding the right link feels great.
Play hundreds of levels and endless mode!

title: Bubble Sorting Infinite Remastered
description: Bubble Sorting Infinite Remastered is a fun and calming puzzle game where you sort colorful bubbles into matching tubes. Just move the bubbles around, stack 3 to 10 of the same color together, and watch them pop away! With endless levels and relaxing gameplay, it’s the perfect brain teaser to unwind anytime, anywhere.

title: Daily Jewels Blitz Mahjong
description: Enjoy Daily Mahjong with a sparkling jewels twist! Play a unique layout every day, match dazzling gem tiles, and keep your streak alive to earn boosters like Hint, Shuffle, Undo, and Torch. Track your longest streak and collect daily rewards as you match your way through beautiful designs. Miss a day? There’s a rare chance to recover it. Relax, match, and dive into the timeless charm of Daily Mahjong with a brilliant jewels theme!

title: ARROW OUT AND LINKER
description:
ARROW OUT AND LINKER is a smart, direction-based puzzle game where every move counts. Your mission is to guide the arrow through intricate mazes and lead it to the exit.

Rotate tiles, shift paths, and think several steps ahead to build the perfect route. Each decision shapes the outcome, rewarding careful planning and shap logic.

title: Knit Rescue
description:
Knit Rescue is an engaging and original puzzle game where you untangle a knitted dragon to save a frightened kitten.

But it’s not enough to simply tap the right spools. You must unlock the correct spools and move them in the right direction to stop the dragon in time.

Plan your moves, follow the arrows, and solve each level using logic and strategy. Knit Rescue is the perfect casual puzzle game for fans of brain games, logic puzzles, and strategy games.

title: Tap Arrow Away
description: Tap Arrow Away is an addictive puzzle game that combines tap-away gameplay, hidden picture discovery, and satisfying pixel art reveals. Remove arrow blocks in the correct order, solve clever brain puzzles, and uncover cute animals, colorful objects, and secret pixel images hidden beneath every level. This relaxing puzzle adventure offers hundreds of levels, rewarding progression, and endless fun for fans of logic games, brain teasers, and hidden picture puzzles.

title: Screw Spin
description:
Screw Spin is a satisfying logic puzzle where you unscrew colorful bolts and sort them into matching boxes. It’s relaxing yet challenging, combining planning, logic, and a touch of strategy.

Each level introduces a new layout with bolts of different colors. Your goal is to clear the entire panel by removing all the bolts, carefully managing your limited storage slots and placing each bolt in the correct container.

title: Match Tile 3D
description: Match Tile 3D is an addictive puzzle, not only connect your brain to logical thinking but also is a fun triple matching game which is easy for everyone to play!

How high can you score?

Sort Flowers is a bright and relaxing puzzle game where you sort flowers by type!
Combine three identical flowers in one pot to grow a lush, beautiful bush.
Plan your moves, create satisfying merge chains, and enjoy the colorful and cozy atmosphere.
Each level brings new combinations, vibrant colors, and delightful visual effects.

title: Block Puzzle: Slide Block Jam

Slide the blocks, beat the clock, and master the puzzle jam!

Block Puzzle Slide: Block Jam – Slide, Match, and Clear the Grid!

In this bridge-building adventure, your task is to draw paths for the car to safely navigate through obstacles and reach its destination. Get ready to embark on a thrilling journey of bridge construction and puzzle-solving as you draw roads to rescue the stranded car!

description: Experience the free online Domino Solitaire challenge with 90 engaging levels! Match domino tiles to clear the board and sharpen your mind in this addictive puzzle game. Use strategy to connect matching ends, tap the closed pile for new tiles, and unleash wild domino power-ups when you’re stuck. description: Monster Escape is a thrilling puzzle platformer where you rotate the entire level to help a little green monster grab the key and escape the dark dungeon. Each stage is packed with tricky obstacles — spikes, falling crates, and narrow passages that put your timing and planning skills to the test. The unique mechanic — rotate the world, find the path, unlock the door — creates plenty of satisfying moments as you advance.

title: Traffic Parking
description: Traffic Parking is a car puzzle game to park the car into the garage of the house, the car is on the road looking for a way to go home by avoiding other cars. Sometimes there are rocks on the road that must be removed so that the car can pass through. You also need tricks at certain levels to make the road passable for cars.

title: Rope Color Sort 3D
description: Rope Color Sort 3D is a creative puzzle game where players need to skillfully sort colorful ropes into their corresponding tubes. The game features beautiful 3D graphics and smooth physics effects, providing players with a relaxing and enjoyable gaming experience.

title: Number Place Travel
description:
Fill the grid with numbers 1–9 so that no same number appears in any row, column, or 3×3 block!
Tap a cell and choose a number to place it.
You can make up to 3 mistakes. Fill in everything correctly to clear the puzzle!

description: The harbor’s a mess! Ships of all sizes and colors are stuck in a massive jam. Pay attention to their direction, plan your moves, and clear the chaos! Need help? Use special power-ups to sail through tougher levels.

Don't you just find peace when everything is in its right place and in harmony? Everything is scattered in total chaos. Only a hero can fight against all this chaos. This is your chance to organize it! Solve ingenious puzzles and organize everything to find harmony at every level. Organize, profit and become the best of the best!

title: Screw Match
description: Screw Match is a colorful puzzle game that tests your logic and coordination. Match screws of different colors to their corresponding glass nut boxes. The rules are simple, but the challenge grows with every level.

Block 3D Puzzle is a colorful logic game where you need to place 3D blocks on the board in the right order. Every move turns into a bright visual effect — when you place a figure and complete a line, the entire line lights up with that block’s color!
Plan your moves carefully, fill the lines, and clear space for new blocks. The game combines relaxing gameplay, smooth animations, and stylish 3D graphics, making every puzzle a true visual delight.

Move hexagon tiles to connect matching knots and create beautiful patterns. Easy to learn, relaxing to play, and perfect for kids and adults — with lots of bright levels and fun challenges for the whole family!

description: 1010 Jungle Blocks is a very interesting block puzzle game. In this game you need to pick and drop the set of blocks on the board. After dropping the set,  if a horizontal or vertical line of 10 blocks is formed, the blocks will be removed from the board. The more number of blocks you remove at once, more score you will get. Don’t let the board crowded with the blocks. You can play till you are able to fit the existing block sets .

title: Word Solitaire
description: Challenge your mind with a fresh twist on a classic with Word Solitaire! This addictive word solitaire blends clever word-building with strategic card gameplay, creating a unique solo experience. Find categories, reveal hidden words, and clear the board in increasingly challenging levels. Perfect for quick breaks or long sessions—relax, think, and master the art of words!

title: Sort Parking
description: Sort cars by type. You cannot park in a full parking lot. Cars cannot be placed in front of different types. You can increase the number of car models with coins available in the game. If you clear many stages, you will get pieces for the background. When pieces of the same type are matched, the background is completed and the background can be changed.

title: Find It - Find The Differences
description: Find It is an engaging puzzle game that tests your observation skills as you search for subtle differences between two nearly identical images. With colorful visuals and beautifully designed scenes, each level presents a fresh challenge. Whether you're spotting tiny details or uncovering hidden objects, Find It will keep you entertained and focused. Hone your attention to detail, enjoy the excitement of finding every difference, and experience hours of fun suitable for all ages!

title: Gold Strike Icy Cave
description: "Gold Strike Icy Cave" is a winter-themed twist on the beloved casual puzzle game, "Gold Strike." Set in a frosty cave, players face sparkling challenges as they mine through icy blocks, aiming to clear colorful clusters of frozen gems. With the familiar gameplay mechanics of its predecessor, this chilly rendition brings a refreshing winter vibe to the strategic and addictive fun, offering a frosty yet exhilarating experience for puzzle enthusiasts.

title: Lipuzz Water Sort Puzzle
description: You will think a lot and have a lot of fun while playing the Lipuzz game. A great game to exercise memory. The aim of the game is to collect liquids of the same color in a container by transferring the liquids in the containers to each other. The most important rule in the game is that the container you want to pour the liquid into must either be empty or the other container must have the same color liquid. If you can't pass the level in the game, you can get another container from the top menu.

title: Bus Jam Escape

Jump into this vibrant web game for quick brain teasers or marathon sessions - every tap pushes you closer to a high-score win.

Every move requires careful consideration, as unmatched screws will fall into the groove at the bottom — once the groove is filled, the game is over.

The classic Hangman game is released. Learn new words while improving your guessing skills.

How high can you score? Earn points and diamonds for each word guessed correctly.

Prevent the stick man from being hanged.

title: Tic Tac Foe
description:
Think you’ve mastered Tic Tac Toe? Think again. Tic Tac Foe reinvents the classic grid battle with over 30 unique power-up cards that transform every match into a strategic showdown.

Freeze cells. Erase symbols. Move pieces across the board. Expand the grid. Block future moves. And that’s just the beginning. Every card you draw can completely shift the momentum—so plan carefully, and outsmart your opponents. Easy to learn. Hard to master. Impossible to put down. Build your strategy, and prove you have what it takes to rise to the top.

Play Tic Tac Foe now and join the battle of brains, cards, and pure skill!

title: Red Escape
description: Red Escape is an immersive adventure puzzle game designed to challenge your logic and problem-solving abilities. Stuck in a sequence of three mysterious rooms, you must think critically, find hidden objects, collect useful tools, and crack complex puzzles to break free. Each room offers unique challenges and secrets waiting to be uncovered. As the difficulty increases, so does the thrill—making every escape a rewarding experience. Whether you're a seasoned puzzle enthusiast or a curious newcomer, Red Escape delivers an engaging gameplay experience packed with mental twists. Are you clever enough to conquer all three rooms and make your ultimate escape?

title: Would You Rather?
description:
"Would You Rather?" stands as the quintessential group game for friends, offering an exciting array of over 120 thought-provoking questions. It's the ideal addition to any gathering, providing a perfect platform for social amusement. This party app promises an engaging experience, catering to both small groups and family settings, fostering shared moments of laughter and discussion. Its offline functionality adds to its versatility, transforming tedious road trips into engaging sessions filled with friendly debates and amusement.

Delve into a myriad of challenging "Would You Rather?" scenarios, spanning from the squeaky-clean to the daringly risqué, poised to challenge and entertain your circle of friends and loved ones. Will you conquer them all? This game sets the stage for an enjoyable and interactive experience, offering endless possibilities for lively conversations and unforgettable moments.

title: TOGETHER
description: Experience the exhilarating journey of TOGETHER, a captivating Platformer game that challenges you to navigate through obstacles by seamlessly switching between multiple players. Strategize and collaborate to conquer each level, utilizing the unique abilities of each character to progress through the mesmerizing black and white 2D world. Engage in a thrilling adventure where teamwork is paramount, as you leap, solve puzzles, and overcome hurdles by swiftly transitioning between players. TOGETHER offers an immersive gameplay experience, blending intriguing mechanics with visually stunning environments.

title: Board Boss
description:
Play this fun and popular game in your browser. Buy houses and land, rent them out and just watch how your empire grows. In this game you only play against two opponents controlled by the computer. But it doesn't mean that the game is boring! It's great fun and it will be a good training if you later want to play against friends.
Board Boss is fan-made version of popular game Monopoly.

title: City Blocks
description: City Blocks is a logical puzzle game where you will be connecting 3 buildings of the same type in order to build a new, larger building. You can continue to do so for as long as you have space to build these buildings, because once you start running low on real estate, the game will get much more difficult. You receive a Joker during the game that can help you out in this situation. It can be used to buy a building of a specific type that you need to combine with 2 others in order to free some space. The larger your city will become, the higher your score will get, so be sure to aim high.

title: The Untitled Happiness Project
description:
As a worker for the Happiness corporation you are sent to the Phaseolus town to make two of its inhabitants - Jonathan Perry and Rachel Portland - happy again.
Follow them during their day routine, explore the town and talk with residents to gain information which will help you solve their case and make them happy again.

You can send us feedback in comments.

title: Stickman vs Stickman 2
description: Stickman vs Stickman 2 is yet another installment into this series where you can expect a ton of new levels with each having a simple goal. Try to get rid of all of the enemies in a given level. To do so, you will have to use as few bullets as you can, since their amount is limited. You won’t always be able to shoot your enemy up front, so try to use the bullet ricocheting from the walls. If you get through all of the levels, be sure to try the first installment!

title: Stickman vs Stickman
description: Stickman vs Stickman is an online puzzle game where you will have a singular objective - to eliminate all of the stickmen in a given level. Your hero will be shooting his weapon, but you only have a limited number of bullets, so be sure to think about how you're going to use them. In each of the levels, there are some obstacles that you need to use or avoid, to shoot your enemies. There’s a total of 60 levels waiting for you, so don’t worry about getting bored. Will you be able to get through all of them on your first try?

title: Bean Jump
description: Bean Jump is an interesting puzzle game where you will be controlling a little bean. Your objective will be to jump around platforms floating on water. There’s a problem however, since you can only jump on a platform once. After you jump away from it, it will disintegrate. There are many other rules that make the gameplay more engaging. The game is offering you a ton of levels, so expect hours and hours of fun. You can also buy new items that can help you break some platforms and thus make the game easier for you. Will you be able to finish all of the levels?

title: Steampunk Genius
description: Steampunk Genius is yet another great online game from PS Games. It’s the same game developer who brought you Genius Mechanic. Likewise, you will be able to build almost anything even in this game. Your only limit is your imagination. It’s all made in a steampunk theme. The game is offering you a ton of models that you can choose from, it can be an airplane, a car or even a robot spider walking around. All you need to do is find enough parts so that you wouldn’t have to remake everything. There are quality graphics available together with tons of fun. The game can also be played on a mobile phone.
